name: Loopavond Gemzen
location: Lambert Dijkslag Atletiekbaan, Heerde, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Loopavond Gemzen is a running event taking place on 13 October 2026 in Heerde, Netherlands. The race is held at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track and offers participants a choice of distances: 3 km and 5 km. The event takes place in typically cool, clear autumn weather, ideal for performing well. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part and enjoy a sporting evening.
course_highlights: Distances of 3 km and 5 km
Held at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track
Cool, clear autumn weather, averaging 14 °C
additional: The event takes place on an athletics track, implying a flat, fast course. The weather is generally cool and clear, which is favorable for performance. The event is held at the Lambert Dijkslag Athletics Track; check details and registration with the organizer beforehand.

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: The Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is a friendly autumn walking event through the beautiful landscapes of South Holland. Participants can choose from five distances and walk for 1 to 4 days through colourful forests, dunes, villages and along the Dutch coast. Along the way, walkers can enjoy music, theatre, atmospheric chill-out spots and welcoming refreshment stops. The routes pass iconic places such as Keukenhof, the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen and historic villages, making this an atmospheric and varied walking adventure for everyone.
course_highlights: Walking routes along the sea, dunes, colourful forests and welcoming villages
Passing through Keukenhof Forest and by Keukenhof Castle
Beautiful natural areas such as the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen and historic polders
additional: Collect your starting pack on Wednesday 14 October 2026 between 17:00 and 20:00 at Museum De Zwarte Tulp in Lisse. Start and finish locations vary by day and distance, with start times ranging from 8:00 to 11:45 depending on the distance. Participants who walk all 4 days receive a medal; those who walk 1–3 days or take part over the weekend receive a commemorative pin. Enjoy music, theatre, chill-out spots and treats along the way. Routes pass historic and natural landmarks such as castles, windmills, polders and nature reserves. Information about route facilities, start and finish locations, and medal distribution.

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Geopark Hondsrug Cross Circuit is a challenging cross-country circuit held in the beautiful Hondsrug area, a unique Ice Age landscape and UNESCO Global Geopark. The circuit consists of several cross-country races organized by different local running groups, where participants can enjoy an active experience in a natural and varied setting. Participants of different ages and ability levels can take part, with special rules for juniors. The circuit promotes sportsmanship and a connection with the landscape.
course_highlights: Run through the unique Ice Age landscape of the Hondsrug
Varied natural areas and challenging cross-country courses
Organized by local running groups, with attention to safety
additional: Participants take part at their own risk and must have adequate insurance. Juniors (ages 12 to 17) may only run the short distance. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participants may be replaced up to one week before the event. Encouragement prizes are awarded at the closing event in Grolloo. The event comprises several cross-country races in the region, with a focus on active movement and discovering the Geopark area.

name: 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: The 50th Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is a running event with several distances, including 1.5 km, 6 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The race is affiliated with the Atletiekunie and offers a varied course for both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Schoonhoven. Prices range from €3.00 to €15.00, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1.5 km to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Affiliated with the Atletiekunie
Held in the Schoonhoven area
additional: Registration is available via online forms, and the event is affiliated with the Atletiekunie. Extra amenities such as a DJ and a poffertjes stall add to the festive atmosphere.

name: Bierrun Groningen
description: The Bierrun Groningen on 17 October 2026 is a sociable social fun run of approximately 8 kilometres through the city of Groningen. Along the route, you’ll visit four local breweries, where you can sample five delicious Groningen beers. There is no timekeeping; the focus is on running together, enjoying beer and discovering interesting stories about beer. The start and finish are at Folkingebrew The Pub, and afterwards there’s a get-together for one last drink and a chance to relax.
course_highlights: Route of approximately 8 km passing 4 Groningen breweries
5 tasting glasses of delicious local beers
Start and finish at Folkingebrew The Pub (Boterdiep)
additional: There are 2 start groups: one at 13:00 and one at 13:30. There is no timekeeping; it’s a social run. An exclusive Runners Bier can be ordered in advance and will be ready on the day. After the run, there’s a get-together with more beer. Participants receive a sporty keepsake and a unique medal at the finish. The route starts at Folkingebrew The Pub, where you can order an exclusive Runners Bier. The event focuses on fun, sociability and discovering Groningen beers.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: The A.Vogelloop is a welcoming running event taking place on 17 October 2026 in 't Harde. The race is organised by the Wallenloop and Havenloop together with A.Vogel, and supports the Opkikker Foundation. The route crosses the beautiful Zwaluwenburg estate, with an unpaved 5-kilometre loop through woodland and a start and finish in the attractive A.Vogel Gardens. The event welcomes both recreational and professional runners, and children can take part in special youth distances, with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Unpaved 5-kilometre loop through the woods and past a woodland pond
Start and finish in the A.Vogel Gardens, among beech trees and rhododendrons
Youth run entirely within the A.Vogel Gardens
additional: Start and finish at the A.Vogel visitor centre. Facilities include a pagoda tent, a water station, coffee, tea and soft drinks for sale, a few product stalls, toilets and a water tap. Prizes for the top three adults and children; medals for all young participants. Parking at Eperweg 3-5; cycling is recommended. The race is organised in collaboration with local clubs and charities, offering a recreational and sporting event for all ages.

description: The Bosse Pielenloop in Vogelwaarde is a friendly running race organised by Voetbalclub Vogelwaarde. The event offers several distances, including a children’s run and longer distances of 4.6 km, 9.4 km and 13.3 km. Every participant receives a traditional Bosse Piel—a duck-shaped biscuit—as a keepsake. The race takes place on Saturday, 17 October 2026, with changing rooms and showers available in the VV Vogelwaarde premises.
course_highlights: Distances of 4.6 km, 9.4 km and 13.3 km
1,000-metre children’s run for children aged 6 to 12
Traditional Bosse Piel biscuit for every participant
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the VV Vogelwaarde premises. Prize-giving and raffle at 16:45. Entry fees can be paid in cash or by card when collecting the race number. Online registration is available and recommended. Start after 14:15. Venue not specified. Includes a traditional Bosse Piel biscuit for participants.

name: Giblo-run
description: The Giblo-run takes place on 17 October 2026 in Beerse and offers a sporting day with running races and walks over various distances. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km and 10 miles, with a well-marked route and refreshments along the way. Children can take part in a scavenger hunt with activities and challenges, and enjoy various activities such as a bouncy castle and climbing park. After the event, there is an awards ceremony, and food trucks will be serving food and drinks. The organisers provide a safe and welcoming atmosphere, with facilities such as a cloakroom and showers.
course_highlights: Route marked with coloured arrows: yellow (5 km), green (10 km), red (10 miles)
Refreshments along the route, with a piece of fruit and water at the finish
Family-friendly activities: scavenger hunt, bouncy castle, trampolines, climbing park and face painting
additional: Registration is available on the day at the GIBLO grass field (Antwerpseweg 48), via the green gate on Tanseleerstraat. Payment is with vouchers, which can be purchased at the entrance using Payconiq or cash. A cloakroom is available at the start, and after the event participants can shower at sports hall 't Beerke, which has communal showers. The awards ceremony takes place on the stage at the GIBLO grass field. Food trucks will serve fries, hamburgers, pancakes and fresh soup. Terrain: urban and park setting; registration by phone or email; includes a children's race and obstacle course, walking routes and a photo scavenger hunt.

name: Singelloop Middelburg
description: The Singelloop Middelburg is an annual running event held in the historic centre of Middelburg. The race offers a challenging 6.75-kilometre course through the city’s atmospheric canals and streets. The event is open to both competitive and recreational runners and is known for its friendly, sporty atmosphere. Organised by Dynamica Sport, it is a well-run race with a broad field of participants.
course_highlights: A 6.75 km course through the historic centre of Middelburg
Run along atmospheric canals and picturesque city streets
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: Dynamica members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering in advance. There is a distinction between official races and recreational runs. Registration is handled through the race secretariats or the website. The run is part of Dynamica Sport’s race programme. The race takes place on 17 October 2026 from 14:00 to 16:30 and is a popular event for runners in Zeeland.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Boerbos Cross in Rolde is a challenging cross-country race through the unique landscape of the Boerbos, part of the UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. The route follows unpaved paths over hills, heathland and sand drifts, with distances for juniors, seniors and masters. The race is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos and is part of the Hondsrug cross circuit. Timing is chip-free, and participant numbers are limited.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through forest and heathland
Historic sand drift with challenging hills
Varied terrain of sand and hills
additional: There are three categories: juniors (ages 12–17, approx. 5 km), seniors and masters, with a short distance (5 km) and a long distance (approx. 9 km). Timing is chip-free. A waiting list may be available if registration is full. Public transport is available, with a stop within walking distance. The course is approximately 5 or 9 km through forest and sand drifts. Registration is via inschrijven.nl. The maximum is 100 participants for the Boerbos Cross only and 250 for the cross circuit.

name: Dutch Backyard Ultra Zeewolde
description: The Dutch Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarun in which participants start the same 6.706 km loop every hour. There is no set finish; anyone who completes the loop within the hour starts again exactly one hour later. The event lasts as long as the participants can keep going, with just one winner: the last runner to complete a loop, the “last man standing.” The route in Zeewolde runs through Scoutinglandgoed and mainly takes in natural surroundings with little elevation gain.
course_highlights: Each loop is exactly 6.706 km long
Route through Scoutinglandgoed Zeewolde with little elevation gain
Natural area with quiet, unpaved paths
additional: Participants must complete each loop within an hour to be allowed to start the next one. No personal assistance is allowed during a loop; only shared aid stations are permitted. Artificial aids such as poles may not be used. Participants who do not finish within the hour receive a DNF. Each runner’s distance is shared. Participants and crew have access to the base camp, an open field the size of a football pitch where the loop starts and finishes. The race is held at Scoutinglandgoed Zeewolde, where campers are not allowed and tents must be 4x4 metres. Only one participant is expected to reach the finish, making the race particularly challenging.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on Sunday, 18 October 2026, and is known for its fast, flat course and rich historical background. The start and finish are at the iconic Olympic Stadium, with a route along the Amstel, past stately townhouses and windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. The event attracts thousands of runners every year and offers an unforgettable experience, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium
Course along the Amstel with beautiful views of townhouses and windmills
Through the city’s green heart: Vondelpark
additional: The marathon is a World Athletics Platinum Label race with a fast course. An official Mizuno race shirt can be ordered, and an international pasta party is held for participants. The 7.5K run takes place on Saturday, finishing at the Olympic Stadium. There are also special business runs and kids’ runs. Globalrunning.com offers travel packages including an entry place, accommodation, and transport. The event also includes a Kids Run, Heroes Run, and charity runs; travel packages are available; registrations and ticket resales are handled through the official websites.

name: MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with all routes offering a hilly course rather than a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it offers a more intimate running experience than large city events. The organiser, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a supervised cloakroom and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of a flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Maximum of 1,400 participants. No on-the-day registration is available. Facilities include public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, an AED, a supervised cloakroom and massage. Typical October weather is cool and crisp, with an average temperature of 14°C, a minimum of 6°C and 40mm of rainfall. Make sure to register in advance; late registrations are not possible. Facilities such as parking, changing rooms, first aid and massage are available. The event is easily accessible by public transport and offers a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Herfstloop Twente is one of the oldest running events in the east of the Netherlands, organised since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes runners through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon routes return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginner runners and young people. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural area near Rutbeek
Original courses for the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon races
The 2-mile distance is suitable for beginner and returning runners, as well as young people
additional: The start and finish are on the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is open from age 11. The organising committee consists of 7 people, with more than 50 volunteers on the day. Participants give the Herfstloop an average score of 8. Registration is via the website. Facilities include free parking, with a medal available for €1.50. The event takes place in the natural surroundings of Enschede.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Winter Cross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country running series in the wooded De Dennen area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race, on 18 October 2026, offers several distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km and 0.75 km, with the start at Nattevlakweg. The route follows scenic, winding forest paths and is suitable for both young runners and adults. The race is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. The start times are 10:30 for children aged 12 and under and 10:50 for all other participants.
course_highlights: Wooded De Dennen area with winding paths
The longest distance on 18 October is approximately 14.7 km, divided into 3 laps
Sheltered start location near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration opens at 9:45 at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Cash payment, preferably with the exact amount, is appreciated; otherwise, a payment request will be sent. Children aged 12 and under run 750 metres and start at 10:30; all other distances start at 10:50. The cross is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. 2026–2027 season, several distances, courses from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45, location: 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: 10 van AVR
description: The 10 van AVR is an annual running race in Rucphen that offers both a 10-kilometer and a 5-kilometer course. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere and challenging course through the region’s beautiful landscape. AVR'90 organizes a socially safe sporting environment and a well-organized day for all participants. The event attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes and is a fixture on the local running calendar.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer and 5-kilometer courses
Run through Rucphen’s beautiful landscape
Friendly, sporty atmosphere
additional: The race offers a good opportunity to run a fast time at the end of the season.

description: The Bunkercross in Olst is a unique and challenging cross-country race, celebrating its 17th edition as the sporting opening of the Sallands Cross Circuit. The entirely unpaved course takes you over historic command bunkers and through the woods of the De Haere estate, an area rich in nature and history. The race attracts a broad field, from regional top runners to enthusiastic recreational runners, and offers a challenging, atmospheric start to the cross-country season. Race numbers are handed out at the impressive De Haere Castle, where runners can also enjoy a friendly chat after the race.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course across the De Haere estate
Passes over historic command bunkers and an emergency hospital bunker
Varied, wooded terrain with challenging climbs
additional: Race numbers are handed out at De Haere Castle, where runners can also enjoy a friendly chat after the race. The Bunkercross is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, which features 10 cross-country races. Start times for the Bunkercross on 18 October 2026 are: 1 km at 10:45, 2 km at 11:15, 5.5 km at 12:00 and 11 km at 13:00. The course is 100% unpaved and runs over historic bunkers and through woods. Entirely unpaved course, historic bunkers, woods, distances from 1 km to 11 km, registration via mijninschrijving.nl

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: The Zeezichtloop Petten takes place on 18 October 2026, starting and finishing at Plein 1945 in the heart of Petten. The event offers various distances for runners and walkers, including a relaxed 10- or 15-kilometre walk, a challenging 5 km running route completed twice, and a festive Kids Run for the youngest participants. The course passes through the village centre, along the dike with beautiful sea views, and through dunes and woodland. Steep climbs and loose sand have been avoided to make the course more accessible. The day concludes with prize-giving and the presentation of the Erik ten Velden trophy to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km.
course_highlights: Route through the village centre and along the dike with sea views, through dunes and woodland
Steep climbs and loose sand have been avoided
A warm encouragement point at Plein 1945 midway through the second 5 km lap
additional: Online registration is open until 17 October 2026 at 17:00. The Kids Run is divided into age categories with different numbers of laps (ages 2–4: 1 lap, approximately 350 m; ages 5–8: 2 laps, approximately 700 m; ages 9–12: 3 laps, approximately 1,100 m). The Erik ten Velden trophy is awarded to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km. Results and photos are available via the website and social media channels. Walkers can choose 10 or 15 km and go at their own pace, without the pressure of competition. Routes along the sea, through woodland and along the dike; registration until 17 October 2026; free parking; rainproof fairground run

name: Rode Loper Run
description: The Rode Loper Run is a friendly and inclusive running event held in the beautiful Vledderbos in Stadskanaal. The route has been carefully mapped using GPS and offers an enjoyable experience for young and old, whether running fast or at an easy pace. There is no official timekeeping, but every participant receives a medal and refreshments at the finish. The atmosphere is central, and the organizers welcome everyone to enjoy exercising in nature together.
course_highlights: Route through the beautiful Vledderbos
GPS-mapped paths with accurate distances
Sanitary facilities available; no showers or changing rooms
additional: Start times: 13:00 Kidsrun, 13:45 Framerunners/wheelchair users, 14:00 Canicross, 14:30 5 and 10 km. On arrival, register at the desk and receive a wristband matching your distance (white/red for Framerunners 2 km, blue for 5 km, yellow for 10 km). No official timekeeping. Medal and refreshments at the finish. The road between Veendam and Stadskanaal will be closed from 05:00 to 16:00 on race day. No official timekeeping, medal at the finish, sanitary facilities available; no showers or changing rooms. In Oosterwolde, Invictus and Rotaryclub are organizing a short schoolchildren’s race, free for schoolchildren.

The event offers a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners alike and takes place between 11:30 and 18:00. The Mjitte Run is an annual event that brings the local community together.

description: The Veluwe Winter Competition 2026-2027 is an accessible mountain bike competition held on a variety of challenging and varied courses in the Veluwe region, including Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede/Lunteren and Zutphen. Races are timed and consist of multiple laps, making them suitable for experienced recreational mountain bikers. The competition comprises up to 9 races and is open to participants with a KNWU or NTFU licence, with enjoyment and sportsmanship at its heart.
course_highlights: Varied courses in and around the Veluwe
Timed races with 5 to 10 laps
An easier B-line is available on difficult sections
additional: The races begin with a draw to determine the first starting rows at Nunspeet and Soest; from Oldebroek onwards, riders are lined up according to the current standings. The starting order of categories 8 & 9 and 10 & 11 alternates from race to race. A transponder is required and is attached to the handlebar plate. Races are timed rather than distance-based and last 5 to 10 laps. The best 5 results count towards the overall standings. A day licence is no longer required; participation without a licence is at your own risk. Registration is via inschrijven.nl and is also possible on-site, with mobile payment or cash. The competition includes several events in autumn and winter at locations such as Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede / Lunteren and Zutphen. Registration is handled via email, and detailed route information is available. Live results are displayed on the website.

name: All4running Crosscircuit
description: The All4running Crosscircuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held in North Holland at various locations, including Hoorn, Wieringerwerf, Den Helder and Spierdijk. The races vary in distance and are suitable for a range of age categories, from juniors to seniors. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races. The circuit offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere, with a ranking and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Varied courses in wooded areas and sports park settings
A range of distances for juniors and adults, from 1,000 metres to 10,000 metres
Races at various locations in North Holland, including Risdammerhout and Dijkgatbos
additional: You can register for the entire circuit or for an individual race. Participants must return their chip after the race to avoid additional costs. A points system determines the final ranking, with the best four results counting and bonus points awarded for taking part in all five races. Found items are kept for 14 days by the organising club. Final prize categories are divided by age and gender. Cross-country races in Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk; registration available on race day; return your chip and prizes awarded to top finishers.

name: Battle of the Zekskes
description: The Battle of the Zekskes is the very first Cornhole tournament in Velden, an accessible and sociable game in which teams of at least four people throw beanbags at a wooden board to score points. The event takes place on 18 October 2025 and is organized by Sportvereniging Velden. Alongside the sporting competition, an evening celebration is also planned, making it a fun combination of competition and socializing for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Accessible cornhole game with beanbags and wooden boards
Teams of at least 4 people
Held at Theo Lommen Sportpark in Velden
additional: The minimum age to participate is 16. An evening celebration is planned after the tournament. Teams consist of at least 4 people. Cornhole game, teams of at least 4 people, evening celebration after the tournament

name: Nacht van de Nacht wandeling
description: The Night of the Night walk in Breda is a special experience where you walk in silence through the darkness and enjoy the natural nighttime surroundings. During the walk, you can experience the peace and quiet and, weather permitting, a beautiful starry sky. The activity highlights the importance of darkness and combating light pollution, and is suitable for a broad audience who enjoy nature and quiet.
course_highlights: Walk in complete darkness
Experience silence and nature at night
Possibility of seeing stars in clear skies
additional: The Night of the Night includes various activities such as walks, boat trips, stargazing and lectures. Some activities are wheelchair-friendly and suitable for children. Participants can sign up via an online form. The campaign aims to raise awareness of light pollution and the importance of darkness for nature and health. Various activities include stargazing, walks, boat trips and lectures, focusing on darkness and the nighttime experience.

name: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE
description: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE is a social running clinic held on the last Sunday of October, starting and finishing at Out Of Office Coffee in Westergas, Amsterdam. The event begins at 11:00 with running drills focusing on technique and speed, followed by a group run accompanied by music. This event celebrates the final day of 30 years of the Amsterdam Dance Event, combining sport and music in a unique and enjoyable way.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Out Of Office Coffee, Westergas
Includes running drills focusing on technique and speed
Group run with music accompaniment
additional: The event is a running clinic open to everyone, emphasizing social participation and enjoyment. It is part of the Amsterdam Dance Event festival program and celebrates the event's 30th anniversary. The venue Out Of Office Coffee is open Fri - Sun 10 - 17 and Tue - Thu 09 - 16. Participants can enjoy a relaxed run combined with music and a convivial atmosphere, perfect for both recreational runners and fans of the dance festival.

name: Duinentrail Schoorl
description: The DYNAFIT Duinentrail Schoorl 2026 is a challenging trail run through the beautiful dune area around Schoorl, Bergen, Hargen and Camperduin, featuring the highest dune peaks in the Netherlands. The trails range from 12 km to 50 km and include a swim trail and various kids’ trails. All routes start and finish at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast makes for a unique and varied running experience, with October weather conditions adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Trail through the highest dune area in the Netherlands
Varied terrain with hills, narrow paths and mud
Start and finish at Laguna Beach, right on the beach
additional: There is a test run/course preview on 17 September. The start and finish location is ideal for runners and supporters. Participants should have experience with off-road terrain and be in good physical condition. Participation is at your own risk. Trail, Swim Trail, beach activities, two-day programme, various distances, start and finish at Laguna Beach Schoorl

name: Heemstedeloop
location: Sportparklaan and Landgoed Groenendaal, Heemstede, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Heemstede Loop takes place on 25 October 2026 in Heemstede and offers an atmospheric running experience through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede. Participants are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and entertained along the way by live music from bands and DJs, creating a festive atmosphere. Several distances are available, including a 1 km FamilyRun for children, a 5 km, and a 10 km route that covers the 5 km loop twice. Organiser SportSupport Kennemerland ensures a well-organised and enjoyable event, with timing and unique medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Route through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede
The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Live music from bands and DJs along the course
additional: The Les Petits 1 km FamilyRun is suitable for children aged 4 and up, with two start groups: groups 1–4 start at 10:00 and groups 5–8 at 10:30. One parent or guardian may run for free with children in groups 1–4. Timing is provided by Chronorace. Registration includes a unique medal, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and changing facilities. Registration is via a digital module. Race numbers are sent by post or handed out on the day. Facilities include changing and shower rooms and a supervised cloakroom.

name: Parkcross Hoorn
location: De Blauwe Berg, Hoorn, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Parkcross in Hoorn, organized by A.V. Hollandia, is an annual cross-country race held at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit and attracts both youth and senior runners. The Parkcross offers a challenging course in a park-like setting, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers are known for their hospitality and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a park-like setting
Challenging terrain with natural features
Suitable for youth, juniors, seniors, and masters
additional: Registration is via Atletiek.nu. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit. The event takes place at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex in Hoorn. The cross-country race is held in Risdammerhout neighborhood park; registration is available on the day. The course features mud and hills, and the location is near Sportpark de Blauwe Berg.

name: Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl
description: The Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl is a unique running event held annually in October, and in 2026 it will celebrate its fourteenth edition. The main distance is 4 nautical miles (7.408 km), taking runners past green spaces, the sea, the harbour, the beach and historic sites in Delfzijl. The race starts at the athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in the town centre. In addition to the individual 4 Zeemijlenloop, there is a corporate run and a kids’ run, making the event suitable for a range of participants. The race has a strong regional character but attracts participants from across the Netherlands. The course is wide, varied and distinctive because its distance is measured in nautical miles.
course_highlights: 7.408 km route past the sea, harbour, beach and green spaces
Starts at the Burgemeester Boeremalaan athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in central Delfzijl
Passes historic sites such as the statue of Maigret and the Damsterdiep
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday evening and Sunday morning at the AV Fivelstreek clubhouse and in central Delfzijl. Late registration is not available for the 4 Zeemijlenloop. The prize-giving takes place after the races. There is a party tent and a post-race gathering after the corporate run. The event takes place in October, with start and registration points at the athletics track and in central Delfzijl, and includes various race categories.

name: Jan de Vos Najaarscross
location: Kralingse Bos, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Jan de Vos Autumn Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in Kralingse Bos in Rotterdam. It is organised by PAC Rotterdam, the oldest athletics club in the Netherlands. The course runs along natural paths with hills, bushes and tree trunks, making for a varied and demanding running experience. The cross is suitable for participants of all ages and attracts many enthusiastic runners each year.
course_highlights: Start at the Beachhouse by the beach in Kralingse Bos
Includes a hill behind the petting zoo
Natural obstacles such as bushes, tree trunks and slippery paths
additional: The cross consists of two laps of approximately 4 kilometres. The race is suitable for participants aged 17 to 70 and over. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and an opportunity to chat over a drink. The aim for next year is to also offer a shorter distance of approximately 4 km for younger athletes. The event takes place in the Kralingse Bos area, a popular location for running races in Rotterdam.

name: Het Achtje van Atledo
description: The Achtje van Atledo is a running event organised by Atletiek- en Trimvereniging Atledo in Dongen. Atledo is a large and active club with a modern athletics track and a wide range of training sessions for all ages and levels. The event takes place in a green sports area alongside the canal and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for both competitive and recreational runners. The club is known for its expert guidance and focus on injury prevention.
course_highlights: Modern athletics track with good grip and cushioning
Located in a green sports area alongside the canal
Facilities for various athletics disciplines in addition to running
additional: Atledo offers training for all levels and ages, including a 'Run for Fun' programme for beginner runners and an 'Older Adults in Motion' programme. The club has a clubhouse with a sports café and extensive facilities for technical athletics events. Running or walking, date 25 October 2026, starts from 10:00.

name: Strand TIEN cross
description: The Strand TIEN Cross on Sunday, October 25, 2026, is the first race in the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition 2026–2027, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races on unpaved courses in and around Oss. The cross offers both a long distance of approximately 10 km and a short distance of approximately 5 km, as well as special youth cross races over shorter distances. The races are suitable for runners of all levels and ages, giving participants the chance to measure themselves against others, pursue personal goals, and enjoy running in nature. Anyone who takes part in at least four races has a chance to place in the overall standings.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km
Special youth cross races over shorter distances
additional: The cross competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races in the same category qualifies participants for a place in the overall standings. The races take place on Sunday mornings and are small-scale and accessible. There is a youth race for younger runners. You can get in touch via WhatsApp or SMS at 06 37 30 12 02. The race is part of a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in Oss, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl.

name: Craft x Luyckx Sport Oercross
location: Former US Military Terrain, Havelterberg, Netherlands
description: The Craft x Luyckx Sport OER Cross is a challenging cross-country race, organised for the seventh time by AV De Sprinter on 25 October 2026. The race takes place on the wooded, hilly training grounds of the former American base in Havelterberg. The OER Cross is part of the prestigious Athletics Union Cross Country Series and serves as a qualifying race for the European Cross Country Championships. There are various distances for youth and adults, divided by age category.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly training grounds of the Ministry of Defence’s Havelte-West site
Located at the former American base in Havelterberg
Part of the Cross Country Series and a European Cross Country Championships qualifying race
additional: Parking is permitted only at the car park of Darper Football and Sports Association; parking on the Ministry of Defence training grounds is prohibited. Flying a drone during the event is strictly prohibited. Test runs are organised in collaboration with Craft and Luyckx Sport to try out the course and new shoes. The OER Cross is one of four top races that count towards the national cross-country ranking. The event takes place at the former American base in Havelterberg, with registration via Inschrijven.nl. The site is known for its challenging, hilly and wooded setting. Parking is available at the grounds of Darper Football and Sports Association. Drone use is not permitted during the event.

description: The Hartekind Run and Social Run is being organized for the third time by Rotary Club Voorburg-Vliet in collaboration with Sparta Voorburg Athletics Club. The event offers several distances: 1 km and 2.5 km junior runs, an 800-meter Social Run, and 5 km and 10 km adult runs. The start is on the athletics track at Sparta Voorburg, and the course runs along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, the cycle bridge, the ADO stadium, and cycle tunnels. All proceeds are donated to Stichting Hartekind, giving the event a social and sporting character.

Course along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, the cycle bridge, the ADO stadium, and cycle tunnels

All event proceeds go to Stichting Hartekind. The exact course and distances are not specified; the event focuses on social and inclusive participation.

name: 11strandentocht
description: The 11strandentocht is a walking event taking place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, along the Dutch coast. Participants can choose from four distances: 50 km, 25 km, 12.5 km and 5 km. Each route passes different beaches, with the sea on the left. The finish is always in the centre of Zandvoort. The event supports the Dutch Heart Foundation in its fight against cardiovascular disease and combines a sporting challenge with a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes run entirely over sand and unpaved paths along 11 beaches
The 50 km distance starts early in the morning (06:30 and 07:00), with a light to help participants before sunrise
There are checkpoint posts, rest stops and medical assistance along the way, including first aid and an AED
additional: Each distance has a different starting location, but the finish is always in the heart of Zandvoort. The 50 km route starts at Deltaplein, The Hague, and is a loop over the beach and boulevard. The 5 km Heroes Route is suitable for walkers setting their own pace. There are 11 checkpoint posts along the way for the long distance and 5 checkpoint posts for the 12.5 km route. The number of entry tickets is limited to ensure personal attention and safety. Distances range from 5 km to 50 km; starting locations vary; the event supports a good cause; the beach route has the sea on the left.

name: Backyard Ultra de Langstraat
description: The Backyard Ultra de Langstraat takes place in Waalwijk on Saturday, October 31, 2026. The race consists of a distance of 7 kilometers and offers runners a challenging and unique running experience in the Brabant region. This ultramarathon is ideal for runners who want to test their endurance in a friendly and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: 7 kilometers per lap
Location in Waalwijk, Brabant
Unique Backyard Ultra format
additional: The race is held in a friendly and sporty atmosphere, with a focus on endurance and perseverance.

name: Dalli-run
description: Athletics club De Gemzen organizes the Dalli-Run every autumn, one of the most beautiful running events of the year, on October 31, 2026. The race takes place in Heerde on the Veluwe and offers a beautiful undulating course past some of the area’s loveliest spots. The Dalli-Run is popular in the region and offers several distances, from short youth races to 15 kilometers for adults. The routes follow paved roads and cycle paths, with starts between 10:00 and 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful undulating course past some of Heerde’s loveliest spots
Paved roads and cycle paths
Several distances: 700m, 1400m, 5km, 10km and 15km
additional: Start times between 10:00 and 11:00. Youth distances: 700 and 1400 meters; adult distances: 5, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course follows paved roads and cycle paths. Organized by Athletics club De Gemzen. The Dalli-Run is an event for runners of all levels, with activities for children and adults. It is organized by a local athletics club and attracts many participants from the region each year.

name: Haarlerbergtrail
description: The Haarlerbergtrail takes place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, and offers challenging trail runs over distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 kilometres. The routes pass through a large part of Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, where runners can enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The organisers aim to make the event climate-neutral and ask participants to bring their own drinking cup. There is no prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Varied terrain, with some paths closed during the bird-breeding season
Beautiful scenery and challenging trail distances
additional: Maximum of 349 participants. Online registration only. Start times: 30 km and 22 km at 12:00, 16 km at 12:15, and 11 km at 12:30. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory; a reusable cup is available to buy for €4. No prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal. Start and finish at Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel. No on-the-day registration. Registration closes on 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if the event is full. The organisers may cancel the event up to 30 October at 20:00. Cycling alongside participants on the course is not permitted. Trail through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park; organised as a climate-neutral event. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory. Maximum of 349 participants; online registration. Race numbers can be collected at De Veldkamp. Limited shower facilities.

name: Moerschanscross
description: The Moerschanscross is an individual cross-country race held in Hulst on 31 October 2026. This is the 40th edition of the event and it is part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie. The race features various age groups and categories, from pupils to M/V 55+, and offers a challenging course for all participants. Registration is open until 29 October at 18:00, with limited late registration available at double the entry fee.
course_highlights: Individual cross-country race with various age groups
Participants range from pupils to M/V 55+
Part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie
additional: Late registration is temporarily available until Friday at 12:00 at double the entry fee; after that, registration is no longer possible. The AERS Groep Crosscompetitie 2026-2027 regulations and the Atletiekunie competition regulations apply. Any images may be published publicly. Registration closes on 29 October at 18:00, with late registration available until Friday at 12:00. The event is supported by Zeeuwse Atletiek and is a fixture of the Zeeland cross-country season.

description: The Pheidippides Run is a unique relay marathon held annually at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track in Utrecht. Teams of seven runners cover the distance of a full marathon together, inspired by the legendary run of Pheidippides. The event is ideal for companies, groups of friends and running clubs looking to enjoy an active and sociable day together. The race starts on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 11:00 and offers a great combination of competition and team spirit.
course_highlights: Relay marathon with 7 participants per team
Distances of 2 × 4.1 km and 5 × 6.8 km per team
Start, changeover point and finish at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available free of charge at the athletics track. The pavilion is open, serving refreshments such as coffee, hot chocolate, bitterballen and beer. The athletics track is easy to reach by bike, public transport and car, but parking is limited and parking is prohibited on Mytylweg. The lineup and running order can be changed on race day. Relay marathon with multiple legs, starting at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track. Participants can register from 1 May to 28 October. The event highlights team spirit and social interaction.

name: Vechtdaltrail
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km
description: The VechtdalTrail takes place on 31 October 2026 in Ommen and offers challenging trail-running routes of 15, 22, 30, 42 and 60 kilometres. The trails feature little asphalt, plenty of singletrack and varied terrain, including forest and sandy paths and rough grassland. The longer distances include several short climbs, especially in the ‘Beerze Bulten’ area, making the 60 km route a true ultra trail. The organisers aim to make the event sustainable, with no disposable cups, and provide individual timing via a chip in the bib number. Registration is only available in advance, and the longest distance has an 8-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Little asphalt, plenty of singletrack
Varied terrain: forest paths, sandy paths and rough grassland
Short climbs in the Beerze Bulten on the 30, 42 and 60 km routes
additional: The VechtdalTrail is a disposable-cup-free event; participants must bring their own collapsible cup or hydration bladder. The 60 km distance has an 8-hour time limit, with cut-off times at aid stations. Timing is provided via a chip in the bib number, which is personalised and may be kept after the event. There is no race-day registration; registration must be completed in advance. A unique event shirt can be ordered during registration. Disposable-cup-free event, advance registration required, no medals, time limits and cut-off times, participants must have their own insurance, safety measures at hazardous locations

name: Veldhoven 10 Miles
description: The Veldhoven 10 Miles is a popular running event in the Veldhoven area. The event is known as one of the most enjoyable runs in the region and attracts many participants every year. The race offers a challenging 10-mile course through the beautiful landscape around Veldhoven. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, making it suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-mile course through the Veldhoven landscape
A varied route with beautiful scenery
A popular, sociable running event in the region

description: The AERS Groep Zeeland Cross Competition is an autumn and winter cross-country series consisting of seven races, organised by regional athletics clubs in Zeeland. The competition is open to everyone, including non-members, and offers various distances for juniors and seniors/masters. Courses consist mainly of grass and forest trails, with potentially muddy sections depending on the weather, so shoes with good grip are recommended. Junior participants always receive a reward, and seniors and masters receive prizes in each category, both for individual races and for the overall competition.
course_highlights: Courses consist of grass and forest trails
Sections may be muddy depending on the weather
Short and long cross-country distances for different age categories
additional: The competition consists of 7 cross-country races during the season. A points table is updated and published after each race. Seniors and masters have a prize-giving ceremony for each category, with both race-day prizes and prizes for the overall competition. Spikes or shoes with good grip are recommended because of the terrain. Cross-country running on grass and forest trails, muddy in rainy weather, short and long distances for juniors and adults, prizes for race winners and overall standings

description: The Snertcross is an annual running race in the Warandebos in Tilburg, organized by T.S.A.V. Parcival. The race is part of the Regio 13 Cross Circuit and the Tilburg Triple. The Snertcross offers several categories and distances, including junior races, a short cross, a women’s long cross, a men’s 55+ long cross, and a men’s long cross. The race features a challenging course with multiple laps, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Junior cross: 2 laps
Short cross: 1 lap
Women’s and men’s 55+ long cross: 3 laps; men’s long cross: 4 laps
additional: Race-day registration is available until one hour before the start of the respective race. Payment is accepted only in cash or via a payment request using a QR code. The Snertcross is part of the Tilburg Triple, where participants who take part in three or more events receive an exclusive medal. Registration is open until a few days before the race, with race-day registration also available. The race takes place in the Warandebos, with parking available on the university campus. There are no changing facilities at the start, but facilities are available at Tilburg University’s sports centre.

name: Lage Vuursche Ultra
description: The Lage Vuursche Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through historic forests around Baarn, with a varied course through deciduous and coniferous forests, heathland and open stretches. The route is followed using a GPX file and offers a great mix of singletrack, forest paths and avenues. There is good support along the way, with no more than 15 km between aid stations, and participants receive a UTMB Index at the finish. This event is part of the Dutch Ultra Series 2026 and is known for its natural beauty and challenging character.
course_highlights: 50 km through historic forests of deciduous and coniferous trees
Varied course with singletrack, forest paths and heathland
No more than 15 km between aid stations; no disposable cups
additional: Start and finish at Natuurcamping De Zeven Linden, with parking available. Pick up your race number and tracker from 08:30 at race headquarters. Time limit: 8 hours; finish by 17:00 at the latest. No disposable cups at aid stations; participants must bring their own race cup or buy one at race headquarters. Participants will receive detailed information by email two days before the event. Maximum 300 participants; no cups at aid stations; start and finish at Kampeerterrein de Zeven Linden.

name: Halloween Citywalk
description: The Halloween City Walk in Veghel is a spooky walk of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel, organised on Halloween evening, 31 October 2026. It is not a running race, but a frightening experience for the whole family, with various scary characters along the route who will give participants a fright. The walk starts between 19:00 and 20:00 at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants may join only when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel
A spooky, eerie atmosphere, with ominous characters along the route
Start at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour
additional: Individuals may participate from age 16; younger participants may join only when accompanied by a parent or adult. Start time is between 19:00 and 20:00. The walk is not a race, but an event with a spooky atmosphere. Registration for the Krollenloop itself is sold out, but registration for the Halloween City Walk is still open. Start at 19:00; registration via the website. Participants aged 16 and over may take part independently; younger participants must be accompanied by an adult.

description: The Boerenkoolloop in Warmenhuizen is a friendly race and fun run over 5 and 10 km, starting and finishing on the AV NOVA athletics track. The course passes through the villages of Tuitjenhorn, Eenigenburg and Warmenhuizen, partly along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk, where the wind can be a challenging factor. After the event, every participant receives a bag of ingredients for a delicious boerenkool mash, sponsored by Koninklijke VEZET. There is also a 1.2 km youth run and an approximately 11 km walk, which follows a partly reversed route. The venue offers spacious changing rooms, hot showers and additional amenities for comfort.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the AV NOVA athletics track
Route along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk
Views of the surrounding landscape, with the wind as a challenging factor
additional: Race numbers are mailed out and should arrive around 30 October. They can also be collected from the Harenkarspelhal next to AV NOVA up to 15 minutes before the start. Spacious changing rooms and hot showers are available. After the event, everyone receives a boerenkool package with sausage, potatoes and herbs. Parking is available at AV NOVA and at Bejo Zaden BV, approximately 800 metres away. The walking event starts between 8:30 and 9:30; participants must reach the finish by 12:30 to receive the boerenkool package. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl until 25 October; same-day registration is not available. Start times are 11:10, 11:25 and 11:35. Start and finish are on the AV NOVA athletics track.

name: Bosloop Malden
description: The Bosloop Malden is a running race with a rich history dating back to 1978, held on Sunday, November 1, 2026. It is a popular event among the smaller running races in the Netherlands, ideal for testing your form two weeks before the Zevenheuvelenloop. The race offers 5, 10 and 15 km routes through the woods, as well as special races for young runners, including the Bambinoloop for children aged 3 to 8 and a 2 km race for children aged 9 to 12. Participation is free for children up to 12 years old, made possible in part by sponsor Medical Training Malden. Registration is open from September 1 through October 30, 2026, and closes once the maximum number of participants per distance has been reached.
course_highlights: Run through the woods of Malden
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 km
Special youth distances: Bambinoloop and 2 km Kidsrun
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the event grounds. The Bambinoloop has two starts: first ages 3–5, then ages 6–8. There is no timekeeping for the Bambinoloop. The 2 km race is part of the Scholenbokaal of the MTM Kidsrun Bosloop Malden. Registration on race day is not possible. Places are limited for each distance. Distances include 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with special races for children; participation is free for children under 12; registration runs from September 1 to October 30, 2026; registration on race day is not possible.

name: Haarlerbergloop
distance_verbose: 30 km, Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
price_range: € 2 voor herinneringsmedaille, overige kosten niet gespecificeerd
description: The Haarlerbergloop is a challenging running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Sallandse Heuvelrug, with almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland. The event takes place over two days: the Haarlerbergtrail, with distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 km, is on Saturday 31 October 2026, while the shorter distances of 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 km take place on Sunday 1 November 2026. The event is small-scale and is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and the CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, where facilities including toilets and a changing area are available.
course_highlights: Almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland
Beautiful routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Steep hills and wide-open views
additional: The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, with toilets and a changing area but no showers. Collecting your race number and leaving your bag are at your own risk. On-the-day registration is not available; advance registration is open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants in the 5 and 10 km races can buy a commemorative medal after the race (€ 2). The trail is limited to 349 participants, and registration closes no later than 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if full. Bringing your own drinking cup is mandatory for the trail; a reusable cup is available to buy (€ 4). There is no prize-giving for the trail, but every participant receives a medal. The 5 and 10 km races donate € 1 per participant to Stichting Support for Nature. Distances: 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 11 km, 16 km, 22 km and 30 km; cross-country event; registration opens in September; contribution to Support for Nature; races include the trail and youth distances.

name: Loop Esch Door
description: Loop Esch Door is a running event in and around the centre of Tubbergen, featuring a challenging, fast course across the Tubbergse Esch. Since 2022, the event has grown into an established race with a welcoming atmosphere and a great mix of competition and recreation. It offers various distances for runners of all levels, including special runs for children and people with disabilities. The start and finish are at Raadhuisplein in Tubbergen, where a friendly, community spirit is also central.
course_highlights: Fast course through the countryside and across the Tubbergse Esch
Start and finish at Raadhuisplein in the centre of Tubbergen
Various distances from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including walking routes
additional: Collect race numbers on 1 November from 08:00 at Tubbergen Town Hall, up to 30 minutes before the start. Walkers can collect their race numbers from 09:00. Parking at the swimming pool on Sportlaan is recommended. There is a water station on the course, and sports nutrition is available after the event. First aid is available along the course. KinderKroon KidsRuns start from 12:45, with different age categories. Prize-giving ceremonies take place shortly after each distance finishes. The event also offers an inclusive run for people with disabilities and has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Maasduinenloop
location: Afferden, Nationaal Park De Maasduinen, Limburg, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Maasduinenloop is an atmospheric running event held in De Maasduinen National Park, starting and finishing at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek in Afferden. The run offers a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings and combines sport with a friendly atmosphere. All proceeds go to burn care at the Expertise Centre for Child Trauma and Burn Care at Radboudumc Amalia Children’s Hospital. The Maasduinenloop welcomes runners of all ages and abilities, with a special focus on young participants through the Kidsrun.
course_highlights: Run through De Maasduinen National Park
Start and finish at atmospheric Golfbaan Bleijenbeek
New routes, including a 10 km loop
additional: Kidsrun start times: 10:30 (up to and including age 7, 500 m) and 10:45 (ages 8 to 11, 1,000 m). All Kidsrun participants receive a medal and a healthy snack. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the Kidsrun, at approximately 11:00. Teams may be all-male, all-female or mixed; the score is the combined time of the three fastest runners. Team members are automatically entered in the individual race at no extra cost. Start and finish at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 km. The course is marked and supervised by traffic marshals and mountain bikers, and timing is provided. Start and finish at Landgoed Bleijenbeek.

name: Warnsborncross

description: The Warnsborncross is a traditional cross-country race held on the beautiful Warnsborn estate near Arnhem. The race follows unpaved paths past streams and ponds, with challenging elevation changes. There are three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 16.5 km, covering 1, 2 or 3 laps of 5.5 km respectively. There is also a 1,200-metre Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old. The start and race-number pickup take place at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through the Warnsborn estate
Running alongside streams and ponds
Challenging elevation changes
additional: Race-number pickup is available from 9:30 until 10:45 at the latest at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen, Kemperbergerweg 671a, 6816 RT Arnhem. The Kidsrun starts at 10:30, and the other distances start at 11:00. Start and registration at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen; the course follows unpaved paths with elevation changes and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit
description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit starts on 1 November 2026 and consists of nine varied running events spread over six months in the Groene Hart. The circuit is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers a platform where taking part matters more than winning. Participants can choose from different distances and benefit from a discounted circuit entry, including a free running shirt and a finisher’s gift for taking part in 8 or 9 events. The circuit encourages participation and promises a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nine varied runs in the Groene Hart
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and half marathon
Route along the picturesque Kromme Mijdrecht river and through Wickelhofpark
additional: Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like at the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate entry. There is a 10 km walk, a Family Run and a G-Run for children up to 12 years old. Lost race numbers can be replaced at the information desk. Changing rooms and showers are available, as is limited bag storage. Coffee, tea and soft drinks are available for collection in the sports hall. The prize-giving takes place in the sports hall. Nine varied runs between November 2026 and April 2027, including short, middle and long distances and a half marathon, with extra rewards for taking part in multiple events.

name: LPR - Last Pirate Running
description: LPR - Last Pirate Running is a running event taking place in Volendam on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The race offers a short distance of 1.6 kilometers, ideal for a fast and challenging running experience. Registration closes on October 20, 2026, and participants can sign up via the specified registration website. The event is organized by ProRun and is suitable for runners looking for a unique and accessible race.
course_highlights: Short distance of 1.6 km
Organized in picturesque Volendam
Fast and challenging course
additional: Registration for the 1.6 km distance closes on October 20, 2026. A training plan for 10 English miles (16.1 km) is available on the website and may help with preparation. Registration for the race was closed as of October 2026; the event is intended for runners who want to enjoy a short and fun race in North Holland.

name: Kievit Sport Twentsche Cross Competitie
organizer: AV Goor, AV Iphitos, ASV Eibergen, AAV Sisu, AC Tion, LAAC Twente
description: The Kievit Sport Twentse Cross Competition is a challenging cross-country series comprising six races in Twente’s beautiful natural areas. The competition offers a unique opportunity to test yourself against peers and enjoy the region’s winter conditions. The races vary in distance and are open to different age categories, from youth to masters. With strong local involvement and sponsors such as Kievit Sport and Wiggers Vleeswaren, this competition is a much-loved event among runners in Twente.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country courses in various natural areas of Twente
Distances range from 1 km for youth to 10 km for seniors and masters
A unique collaboration between six athletics clubs in the region
additional: Race numbers can be collected at locations such as Zwembad de Vijf Heuvels (Markelo). Changing rooms and toilets are available. For age categories, the reference date is the participant’s age at the final race for youth and at the first race for masters. The competition is made possible in part by local sponsors and six athletics clubs. A 2.5/5 km Canicross distance is also held during the Hulsbeekcross. The competition includes races such as Hessenheemcross, Wintercross, Oudejaarscross, Rutbeekcross, Hulsbeekcross and Dinkelcross, with results and standings available on the official website.

name: Maple Leaf Wintercup
organizer: GAC Hilversum en de Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging

description: The Maple Leaf Wintercup 2026, held on Sunday, November 1 at Bosbad De Vuursche in Baarn, is an atmospheric running and walking event set against a beautiful autumn backdrop. The race is organized by Gooise Atletiek Club Hilversum and Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging and offers challenging unpaved courses surrounded by autumn colors. There are various distances for both walkers and runners, including youth distances and recreational runs with and without a competition licence. The start and finish are on the atmospheric grounds around Bosbad De Vuursche, creating a fun and sporty atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging unpaved course amid autumn colors
Long Cross of 9.5 km with 4 laps
Short Cross of 3.1 km with 2 laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected from October 25 through 31 at Run2Day Hilversum or on race day at race headquarters. There is no separate gender categorization for the Short and Long Cross. Pupils of the organizing athletics clubs can participate free of charge after registering via the contact form. There is a recreational run and a competition-licence run for the short and long cross. The courses consist of multiple laps depending on the distance. The course includes unpaved paths, with events such as Nordic walking, cross-country running and youth races; start and finish at Bosbad De Vuursche.

name: Spaarnwoudecross
description: The Mokums Cross Circuit is a series of four woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area, including the Spaarnwoude Cross, organized by Haarlem Atletiek in Spaarndam. Participants register for at least three of these races and have a chance to receive a fun memento. There is a standings competition for the main events, with each runner’s best three results from the four races counting. The circuit is made possible through a partnership between five Amsterdam athletics clubs and their sponsor.
course_highlights: Woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area
Four different locations: Spaarndam, Amsterdamse Bos, De Eenhoorn, Gaasperplas
A memento for participants in at least three races
additional: Participants in at least three races receive a memento. The 20 fastest men and women in the main events score points toward the overall standings. The prize-giving takes place at the first race of the season. A muddy cross-country race and family and youth event, held on 2 November 2025 in Haarlem at Wheelerplanet in Spaarndam, with participants such as Tessa Weening and Sophie Kwak.

name: Hermans Assurantiën Duatlon
description: The Hermans Assurantiën Duathlon, organised by AVR'69, is a well-known off-road run-mountain bike-run event held in the beautiful forests of Reusel. The 25th edition takes place on Sunday, 1 November 2026, and offers both competitive distances (14 km running, 60 km mountain biking, 7 km running) for athletes aged 18 and over, and recreational distances (7 km running, 30 km mountain biking, 3.5 km running) for participants aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at sports park D'n Hoek, which also has ample changing and shower facilities. Participants can register individually or as a team, and a hot meal is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Run-mountain bike-run event in the forests of Reusel
Off-road course; mountain bikes are required
Start and finish at sports park D'n Hoek, with good facilities
additional: All events start together at 10:00. Participants must use a mountain bike. A hot meal is provided after the race for competitive athletes. Parking is available at the sports park D'n Hoek car park, but cars are not allowed inside the sports park. There are ample shower and changing facilities in the AVR'69 clubhouse. Cash prizes and medals are awarded in the competitive and recreational categories. You can register individually or as a team (a running and cycling duo). The race takes place on 1 November 2026, and registration is open from 10 April 2026 to 31 October 2026. The race starts at 10:00 and requires a mountain bike. Participants must be at least 18 years old for the main race and 16 for the recreational event.

name: Van de Meerendonk Heidetrail
location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Oirschot, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Van de Meerendonk Heath Trail is a beautiful recreational event across the expansive Oirschot heathland, suitable for runners and walkers. The routes are clearly marked with arrows, making it impossible to get lost. Water and fruit stations are available on all distances, and afterwards you can enjoy a friendly atmosphere with free coffee or tea and a treat. The event starts at Gilde Sint Sebastiaan in Oirschot, with several distances available for both running and walking.
course_highlights: Expansive woodland and heathland
Routes clearly marked with arrows
Water and fruit stations on all distances
additional: Start location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Wintelresedijk 1, 5688GW Oirschot. Runners start between 8:30 and 9:30, walkers between 9:00 and 9:30. Toilet and changing facilities are limited; there are no showers. Free coffee or tea and a treat are available after the event until 13:00. Members of Atletiek Oirschot pay €5,00 for all distances when registering in advance. Registration and payment on the day are possible but discouraged. Routes are marked with arrows; water and fruit stations are available on all distances. Start time is between 8.30 and 9.30. There are no prizes. Free coffee and tea are provided after the event. Participation is at your own risk. Facilities are limited, with no showers.

name: Leesten Cross
description: The Leestencross is a recreational cross-country race held in the beautiful woodland around Ugchelen. The race offers a challenging course along forest, sand and heathland paths, with no muddy sections, and rewards you with a magnificent view over the heath. It’s an ideal opportunity to test your fitness and race performance in a welcoming and accessible setting. The start and finish are at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten, a top destination for runners in the Netherlands.
course_highlights: Course along forest, sand and heathland paths
Magnificent view over the heath
Start and finish at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten in Ugchelen
additional: After handing in your race number, you will receive a voucher for a refreshment. No changing facilities are available. First aid is available. The 10 km race counts toward AV Veluwe’s cross-country club championship. Trail run on sand paths in Kroondomein, approximately 60 metres of elevation gain, registration closed, start/finish location: Wildrooster Wenum-Wiesel, no showers or changing facilities, first aid available.

name: Twentse Smokkel Trail
description: The Twentse Smokkel Trail is a unique trail run in the border region of Losser, taking place on 1 November 2026. The routes are 90% unpaved and cross varied terrain with many singletracks, taking participants to places where running is normally not allowed. There are several distances, from challenging 27 km and 22 km runs to a 10 km Drop Off Trail, where participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. In addition to the trail runs, there is a walking trail and a kids’ trail. Participants symbolically smuggle a packet of butter across the border and receive a Twentse krentenwegge after the finish as a reward.
course_highlights: 90% unpaved paths with many singletracks
The route passes through unspoilt forests and nature ponds, and along the Dinkel
A unique border crossing with symbolic butter smuggling and musical support along the way
additional: Refreshment stations are located at approximately 11 km and 4 km before the finish, plus a water station 2 km before the finish. The start and finish are at the Multifunctionele Accommodatie, Nilantspad 3 in Losser, where changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. The 10 km Drop Off Trail starts at the German monastery in Bardel; participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. Timing is provided for the 27, 22 and 14 km trails, but not for the 10 km Drop Off Trail. Dogs are not allowed. After the finish, participants receive a wooden medal and a Twentse krentenwegge. The three fastest men and women in each distance are presented with a handmade smuggling trophy. Trail and walking routes on unpaved paths, including a kids’ trail and a drop-off trail, with a theme of smuggling history and experiencing nature. Registration opens on 1 July 2026 via inschrijven.nl, with participant limits for each distance and refreshment stations at 11 and 23 km.

name: De 4 daagse van Girona
description: The 4-day Girona is an intimate walking event in Spain, organised for a maximum of 300 participants. From 4 to 7 November 2026, you’ll walk through the beautiful and varied landscapes of the province of Girona, on routes that start and finish in Girona’s historic centre. Around 70% of the trails are unpaved, taking you through fragrant forests and rolling hills, with a few climbs that require good fitness. The event is offered as a complete package including accommodation and breakfast at Hotel Ibis Girona, with a convivial get-together after the final day of walking.
course_highlights: Around 70% unpaved trails through forests and along rivers
Start and finish in Girona’s medieval centre
Varied routes with flat sections and short climbs
additional: Participants stay at Hotel Ibis Girona, which is also the start and finish location. Transport to and from Barcelona Airport is arranged to coincide with recommended flights. There is a celebratory get-together after the final day of walking. The daily routes range from approximately 18 km to 26 km, with a choice of a shorter route or a longer route with an extra loop. 5 hotel nights, walking route, medal, briefing, breakfast, lunch, transport, insurance, dinner optional, extra nights available

name: NightRun Rijssen
description: NightRun Rijssen takes place on Thursday, 5 November 2026, offering a unique evening experience as participants run through the centre of Rijssen, past beautiful buildings and businesses. This is not a race; it’s all about fun and the experience, with a magical atmosphere created by the lighting and evening setting. There are several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, a 5 km walking or running route, and a 10 km route for the more ambitious. The start and finish are in the centre of Rijssen, with a rolling start to keep participants moving smoothly.
course_highlights: Run through the centre of Rijssen during late-night shopping
The route goes right through buildings and businesses
Magical, festive atmosphere with lighting and evening decorations
additional: Start and finish in the centre of Rijssen at 'T Schild (next to Pearle). Rolling start in small groups to keep participants moving smoothly. The finish is at Lucky, Morsweg 8. No timing, and it is not a race. There is an opportunity to warm up at NightRun Borne on 9 October. The event takes place during late-night shopping in Rijssen city centre; it is not a race and is focused on fun and the experience. Participants light up the streets and enjoy a festive atmosphere.
