name: Batavia Night Run
description: The Batavia Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 6 November 2026, in the illuminated Batavia Quarter in Lelystad. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres. The course runs through the historic, atmospherically lit area around Museum Batavialand, creating a unique nighttime running experience. The organisers also support the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Course through the atmospherically illuminated Batavia Quarter
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km
Kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres
additional: Registration includes entry to the atmospheric night run. A Batavia Night Run shirt and cancellation insurance can be ordered as extras. The organisers work with photographers and videographers to produce promotional images. Participants must comply with the applicable traffic regulations and RIVM guidelines. Night run with registration available; charities involved; the event combines sport and entertainment in an atmospheric setting.

name: 28e Nacht van OLAT / Kennedy Trail
description: The 28th Nacht van OLAT/Kennedy-Trail takes place from Friday evening, 6 November, to Saturday, 7 November 2026, in Oirschot, the Netherlands. Participants can choose from three distances: 110 km, 80 km and 55 km, with start times in the evening and at night. The route combines paved and unpaved paths, with extensive aid stations and a pasta meal for the 110 km and 80 km runners after the night stage. All participants must finish by 19:00 on Saturday. They receive a certificate, and a medal is available for an additional fee.
course_highlights: A partly paved, partly unpaved route, with longer unpaved sections during the day
Extensive aid stations with food and drinks
Pasta meal for 110 km and 80 km participants after the night loop
additional: Start times: 110 km at 20:00; 80 km and 55 km at 23:00. Registration is approximately one hour before the start. Dogs are not allowed. All participants must finish before 19:00 on Saturday. A medal is optional for an additional fee. Night trail race with multiple distances and support; registration approximately one hour before the start; finish before 19:00 on 7 November 2026; medal available for a fee.

description: On November 7, 2026, the very first LoveLife Run will take place in Terneuzen. This special running event brings together (former) cancer patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals to run 5 kilometers. The event aims to turn feelings of helplessness into strength and raise money for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to take part or support participants with a donation. Proceeds will go to cancer research and local care initiatives. The event is organized by Zeeland Business and volunteers.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer running route
Run together with (former) cancer patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals
Location at ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte in Terneuzen
additional: Participants receive a sports shirt and a medal. Food, drinks and entertainment will be available. (Former) cancer patients can participate for free and will be supported with running training sessions in the lead-up to the event. Sign up for training by September 1; registration without training is open until one week before the event. Sustainable travel by bicycle or public transport is recommended. The event starts at ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte and is supported by Atletiekvereniging Scheldesport. Participants can collect donations and show their support for people affected by cancer.

name: De Najaarsloop van Cialfo
description: The AV Cialfo Autumn Run is a running event held in Epe and organized by AV Cialfo. The run takes place on Wachtelenbergweg and offers participants a great opportunity to be active in the autumn in a sporty and welcoming atmosphere. Pre-registration is available until the end of October, with on-the-day registration open until 30 minutes before the start. The event attracts runners from the region and is part of the local sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Location on Wachtelenbergweg in Epe
Autumn running event
On-the-day registration available until 30 minutes before the start
additional: Pre-registration is open through 27 October via inschrijven.nl. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of the run. Run at Wachtelenbergweg, Epe; date has already passed; registration via online platform.

description: The Dorps Run Renswoude takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, and offers a suitable distance for every runner, from beginners to experienced athletes and young runners. Participants can run individually or register as a team for the corporate competition. The event is known for its friendly, sporty atmosphere in the village of Renswoude, with routes through the surrounding area. Previous editions sold out quickly, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon, consisting of two laps of the 10.5 km route
10.5 km route through the village and surrounding area
1 km Kids Run for young runners
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 11:30 until half an hour before the start. A timing chip is attached to the back of each race number. All participants receive a medal after the event. Showers and changing rooms are available at De Hokhorst sports hall. Event photos will be posted on the website a few days afterwards, without names and with respect for privacy. Parking is available near De Hokhorst, a short walk away. The nearest train station is Veenendaal/De Klomp, with bus connections to Renswoude. Online advance registration is open until 5 November 2026; Kids Run registration is also possible on the day. Start times: half marathon at 13:45, 10 km at 14:00, Kids Run at 12:30.

description: The Duifpolder training run is a small-scale running race through the beautiful Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland. Organised in spring and autumn by De Hardloper Schipluiden, the event offers three distances: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km. The race starts at 14:00 at the Trambrug in Schipluiden, close to the registration and changing venue. It’s an accessible event and ideal for training, with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to chat afterwards in the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse.
course_highlights: Small-scale race through the Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland
Three distances to choose from: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km
Start at the Trambrug, close to the registration venue and clubhouse
additional: Registration takes place at the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse, Zouteveenseweg 2a, Schipluiden. Registration opens at 12:45. Changing facilities and toilets are available, but there are no showers. Drinks are available in the clubhouse after the race. Start location: Trambrug, Schipluiden; no shower facilities; drinks available after the race

name: Plantsoenloop
description: The Plantsoenloop Groningen is Groningen’s oldest and most beautiful running race, suitable for young and old, with four different distances. This atmospheric event takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, and takes participants along a beautiful hilly course through Noorderplantsoen. This 68th edition is a true running classic that should not be missed in your calendar.
course_highlights: Beautiful hilly course
Run through Noorderplantsoen
Four different distances for all ages
additional: Four different distances, course through Noorderplantsoen, organised from Sportcentrum Kardinge

name: Salbam Lemelerbergloop
description: The Salbam Lemelerbergloop is a challenging cross-country race held on the Lemelerberg near Ommen. The race is part of the Vechtdal Cross Competitie and offers several distances: a 2 km youth race and approximately 6 km and 12 km races for adults. The course is entirely off-road and hilly, with significant elevation changes in the Lemelerberg nature reserve, the largest nature reserve managed by Landschap Overijssel. The race is ideal for runners who enjoy a challenging trail run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course
Hilly terrain with significant elevation changes
Lemelerberg nature reserve near Ommen
additional: Start times: 2 km youth race at 12:30, 6 km at 13:00, 12 km at 14:00. The race is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competitie, which consists of five races in total. To be eligible for the overall win, participants must take part in and finish four of the five races. Several distances, start times for youth and adults, and part of a regional cross-country competition.

name: Schipholloop
location: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Haarlemmermeer, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schipholloop returns on 7 November 2026 as a unique running event around Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. With a rich history spanning more than 50 years, this 60-kilometre ultrarun offers a pure, partially self-supported trail experience focused on the experience and the challenge. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon and the ultrarun, and enjoy a beautiful route through the varied polder landscape, with breathtaking views. With a limited field of no more than 100 participants, it is an exclusive and unforgettable run for long-distance runners of all levels.
course_highlights: An iconic 60 km ultrarun around the Haarlemmermeerpolder
Beautiful, varied surroundings with unexpected and breathtaking views
Trail-style run with GPS navigation and full autonomy
additional: A maximum of 100 participants per edition. Not a traditional race with tape and traffic marshals. The run is partially self-supported and trail-style, with GPS navigation and fixed checkpoints. A special tryout edition was held on 23 May ahead of the November edition. Limited to 100 participants, with facilities such as drop bags, aid stations with drinks and snacks, and medals for finishers. The event emphasises the experience and natural surroundings, and is organised as a private initiative and by AV Haarlemmermeer.

name: Waalbosrun
location: Bezoekerscentrum De IJsvogel, Rijsoord, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Waalbosrun is a fun and sporty running event organised by IJsclub Rijsoord in collaboration with De IJsvogel visitor centre. Participants follow a beautiful route through the Waalbos in Rijsoord, along green paths, waterways and wooded areas. The event is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners, with different distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the visitor centre, where supporters are welcome to cheer on the runners. Alongside sport, the event celebrates a friendly atmosphere and community spirit, and part of the proceeds go to charity.
course_highlights: A beautiful route through the Waalbos along green paths
Run alongside waterways and through wooded areas
Start and finish at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre
additional: There are three distances: the Kidsrun (approx. 1.8 km) starts at 12:00, the 10 km starts at 13:00, and the 5 km starts at 13:10. The start and finish are at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre. The event is suitable for all ages, and part of the proceeds go to charity. Participants contribute to a good cause; the event takes place in autumn, when cool and changeable weather is expected.

name: Watersley Halloween Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM WALK € 15 Walk the trail in a small group. Pick a time slot between 18:20 and 20:00.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM RUN € 15 Run the short loop through the forest. Joint start at 18:00. Your time gets recorded.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 KM RUN € 18 The full route. The darkest parts of the park and forest. Joint start at 18:00.

description: The Watersley Halloween Trail takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, in Sittard. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run or a challenging 10 km run through the darkness of Watersley park and forest. The evening begins with an exciting experience in the Haunted House at Watersley Plaza and ends at The Monastery with a free drink. The routes are atmospherically lit and feature hidden actors, creating a unique and spooky trail experience.
course_highlights: Start in the Haunted House with an exciting walkthrough experience
Routes through the park and forest with 14 illuminated points and hidden actors
Finish at The Monastery with a free drink (hot chocolate or lemonade)
additional: The start location is Watersley Plaza, Watersley 31, Sittard. The 5 km walk takes place in small groups, with flexible start times between 18:20 and 20:00. The 5 km and 10 km runs start together at 18:00 and are timed using RaceGorilla. Minimum age: 8 years for the 5 km and 16 years for the 10 km. Children under 12 may participate only when accompanied by an adult. Parking is free. The trail includes forest paths and illuminated points, a Haunted House experience, free parking and a free drink at the finish. Registration is available for both timed and untimed routes, with age restrictions for each distance.

name: Zuidduinloop
location: Katwijk aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Zuidduinloop is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful coastal areas of the Netherlands. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always fantastic, and the event invites everyone to enjoy running outdoors. The Zuidduinloop takes place in Katwijk aan Zee and is part of a series of running events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune trails and beach sections
Unique coastal setting in Katwijk aan Zee
Suitable for a range of ages and abilities
additional: There are rankings for all distances, separated into girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Race in Katwijk aan Zee, with various distances including short kids’ runs and longer races, plus GPX routes and results.

name: Knallende Kilometer
location: Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1

description: De Knallende Kilometer is a unique running event organized by Athletics and Walking Club De Kieviten, taking place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas in Bergschenhoek. It is a time-trial start, with each runner setting off individually at 30-second intervals, giving you the chance to run a fast kilometer on a straight, flat course. Afterward, instead of a medal, you’ll receive a delicious pancake or a warm bowl of snert as a reward. The event is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners looking to enjoy a friendly run.
course_highlights: Straight, flat 1,000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel
Start near the 'Zwijnenplaats' car park and finish near the 'Mollenplaats' car park
Individual time-trial start from 11:00, with a new runner setting off every 30 seconds
additional: Collect your race number at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas. The best place to park is Mollenplaats. After finishing, you’ll receive a pancake or a bowl of snert at the restaurant. Participants will receive their start time by email one week before the event. On-the-day registration is not possible, and places are limited. Flat, 1,000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel; start at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas; parking at Mollenplaats; advance registration required.

name: Athlos Hydro Trail Run
description: The Athlos Hydro Trail Run takes place on Saturday, November 7, in Harderwijk, Veluwe. This trail run offers a challenging route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwe, where participants can enjoy autumn scenery and water crossings. The event is organized by Atletiekvereniging Athlos, known for its involvement in the local running community. The Hydro Trail Run is a sporting and recreational event for trail runners who enjoy a varied course.
course_highlights: Trail run through the natural surroundings of the Veluwe
Beautiful autumn scenery
Water crossings and challenging terrain
additional: Photos from the 2025 edition are available in various albums. The start and finish of the routes are in the center of Harderwijk. The organizers use mobile photographers to capture water fun and other moments. Trail run over varied terrain, including forest, heathland, and sand; registration open; collaboration with sponsors; practical information and results available.

name: Slangenburg trailrun
description: The Slangenburg Trailrun takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, at De Pokkershutte in IJzevoorde. This trail run takes you along winding forest paths and unpaved routes, surrounded by the beautiful autumn colours of the Slangenburg forest. There are four distances to choose from, including a special Kidsrun for young trail runners aged 6 and up, and an official half marathon of 21.1 kilometres. The atmosphere is relaxed, with the focus on enjoying nature and exercising outdoors, without an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and unpaved routes
Autumn colours in the Slangenburg forest
Official half marathon route of over 21 kilometres
additional: There are aid stations along the way with drinks and snacks. First aid is available during the trail run. Parents may accompany their child during the Kidsrun, provided they are registered themselves and have a race number. After the event, every participant receives a free bowl of split pea soup with rye bread and bacon. Free parking is available at the venue. There is no awards ceremony; the focus is on having fun and enjoying nature. Drinks and snacks are available to buy at De Pokkershutte after the event. Trail through forests, online registration, start and finish at De Pokkershutte, free parking, parents may accompany children, no awards ceremony

name: JM ATB toertocht
location: Restaurant de Babbelaar, Oostkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The JM ATB tour is an annual mountain bike ride held on the first Saturday of November in Oostkapelle. The beautifully marked 30 and 50 km routes take riders through forests, country lanes, dikes and surprising trails on Walcheren, without going onto the beach. The ride starts between 08:30 and 10:00 at restaurant De Babbelaar, where participants can also enjoy food and drinks and chat after the ride. It attracts more than 300 to 400 participants each year and is known for its excellent organisation and on-route support.
course_highlights: 30 and 50 km routes through forests, country lanes and along dikes
Beautiful, varied trails on Walcheren
On-route refreshment station and bike-washing facility after the ride
additional: You can start between 08:30 and 10:00 from restaurant De Babbelaar, Dorpsstraat 18, Oostkapelle. There is a refreshment station along the route and first aid is available. After the ride, firefighters will wash bikes at the fire station. Helmets are compulsory; participation is at your own risk. There are no showers and no breakdown support, so bring your own repair kit. Parking is available near the start location. Routes pass through forests, country lanes and along dikes; start and finish at restaurant De Babbelaar; register in advance via inschrijven.nl; participation is at your own risk, helmet compulsory; no showers; first aid available; no breakdown support; car parking at Domburgseweg/Ambachtsstraat and Dorpsstraat

name: Feesteloop
price_range: Kinderloop: 6-7 euro, 5 km en 10 km: 12-14 euro, teamrun: 18-21 euro
description: The Feesteloop in Avelgem is a friendly, sporty running event taking place on Saturday, 7 November 2026. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km race and various kids’ runs, and is suitable for both recreational runners and teams. The start and finish are centrally located, with changing rooms and showers available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. The team run combines 5 km and 2.5 km legs, with handovers in a closed-off zone, making the event suitable for teams and clubs as well.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Avelgem
Kids’ runs of 500, 750 and 1,000 metres
Team run with handovers in a closed-off transition zone
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. In the team run, the first runner covers 5 km, followed by two runners who each cover 2.5 km, with handovers in a closed-off transition zone. The kids’ runs start at 14:00, with different distances for boys and girls born in 2019 or later. Participants can choose 2 or 4 laps of 2.5 km, with a festive atmosphere and podium ceremonies. Online registration is available until 6 November.

name: Olympisch Stadionloop 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: € 16,50 (voor bedrijfs- en scholierenloop, inclusief €2,50 naar UNICEF)
description: The Olympisch Stadionloop 2026 takes place on November 8 at the iconic Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam. Organized by Athletics Club Phanos in collaboration with Run2Day, this running event includes an 800-meter race for children and 5- and 10-kilometer races for individuals, school groups, and corporate teams. The routes pass through the Olympic Stadium and Amsterdamse Bos, and the race is part of Rondje Mokum 2026. The Olympisch Stadionloop combines sport with a good cause, as participants run in support of UNICEF.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam
5- and 10-kilometer routes through Amsterdamse Bos
800-meter children’s race inside the Olympic Stadium
additional: Start times are subject to change: 10:30 for the 800m race for children up to age 8; 10:45 for the 800m race for children aged 9–12; 11:15 for the 5 km individual race, school race, and corporate teams; 12:30 for the 10 km race and corporate teams. Participants in the 5 km and 10 km races can start in designated start pens. Race numbers are distributed before the race. Medals and water are available after the finish. AV Phanos may use photos and video footage for communications. Registration is via online forms; changing rooms and showers are available for teams. The event is part of a series of local runs and takes place in and around the Olympic Stadium in Amsterdam.

name: LoveLife Run Deventer
description: LoveLife Run Deventer is a special running event taking place on 8 November 2026, where (former) cancer patients take part alongside their loved ones and healthcare providers. Participants can choose to walk or run 1 or 5 kilometres, aiming to reach the finish at their own pace, with no timekeeping. Special training sessions led by experienced running coaches from AV Daventria 1906 are offered to help participants prepare. Proceeds from the event go towards groundbreaking cancer research and local causes at Deventer Hospital, Kenniscentrum Oncologie and IPSO centrum Salland. Everyone is welcome to take part, including people who have not had cancer themselves.
course_highlights: 1- and 5-kilometre routes around Deventer Hospital and the Brinkgreven grounds
Wheelchair-accessible routes for both 1 km and 5 km
Start and finish at Radiotherapie Groep, next to Deventer Hospital
additional: Participants receive a mandatory LLR shirt, which is handed out on the day. There is no timekeeping; the aim is to reach the finish. There are 12 weeks of guided training for (former) cancer patients, led by AV Daventria 1906, starting on 19 August 2026. The event is organised by a local team of volunteers and supported by running coaches. Participants are advised to travel sustainably by bike or public transport. Participation is at your own risk. Participants are encouraged to use sustainable transport and wear an LLR shirt supplied by the organisers. The event is free for participants and focuses on fundraising for cancer research and local causes.

name: AV Salland Crossloop Raalte
location: Landgoed ’t Reelaer en Raalterwoold, Raalte, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The AV Salland Crossloop in Raalte is a challenging cross-country race that has been held around Schouwburg 't Hoftheater since 2009. The route passes through the wooded estate of 't Reelaer and the undulating terrain of Raalterwoold, with approximately 90% unpaved paths. The course features woodland sections, avenues, meadows with elevation changes, and sometimes muddy stretches, making for a varied and demanding running experience. There are short youth races and more demanding 5 and 10 kilometre distances, and the race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Approximately 90% unpaved paths
Routes through the estate of 't Reelaer and Raalterwoold
Woodland sections, avenues, meadows with elevation changes, and muddy stretches
additional: The race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Construction work is visible around the Hoftheater, offering an extra glimpse of the surroundings. Results and course records are kept, and previous results are available through the race administration. The race offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km, as well as short youth races. The course is characterised by natural, often muddy paths and varied scenery.

name: AVW Dijkgatboscross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km
description: The AVW Dijkgatboscross is a cross-country running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Wieringermeer in Wieringerwerf. The race offers a challenging course through Dijkgatbos, suitable for different ability levels and ages. The organizers are known for creating a friendly, sporting atmosphere, welcoming both young people and adults. AV Wieringermeer encourages people to exercise together at every level and offers expert guidance.
course_highlights: A course through Dijkgatbos on natural terrain
Suitable for both young people and adults
Organized in a friendly, sporting atmosphere
additional: Participants can register on race day; the venue offers a natural and challenging setting for runners; the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Landgoedloop
location: Landgoed Visdonk, Roosendaal, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Landgoedloop is an annual event in Roosendaal, organised by Atletiek- en Recreatiesport Vereniging THOR. It takes place on the second Sunday of November at Landgoed Visdonk and consists of three activities: a fairy-tale walk, a trail run and walking tours. The trail run offers challenging 6 and 10 km routes, mostly on unpaved paths, while the walking tours cover distances of 6, 10 and 20 km. The fairy-tale walk is a 3 km woodland walk featuring fairy-tale characters and nature puzzles, specially designed for families and children. All proceeds from the event go to Natuurmonumenten West Brabant.
course_highlights: 6 and 10 km trail runs on unpaved paths at Landgoed Visdonk
Walking tours of 6, 10 and 20 km through wooded surroundings
3 km fairy-tale walk with fairy-tale characters and nature puzzles
additional: The trail run starts at 9:00, with distances of 6 and 10 km. The fairy-tale walk starts between 11:00 and 13:30. The walking tours start between 8:00 and 10:00. Dogs are permitted on the fairy-tale walk under strict conditions (kept on a leash, owners must clean up after them). Same-day registration is possible for an additional €1, only if places are still available. Trail runs of 6 and 10 km, fairy-tale walk, start times between 8:00 and 13:30, proceeds go to Natuurmonumenten

name: Schoonhovencross
description: The Schoonhovencross takes place on Sunday, 8 November 2026, in Hollandscheveld, organized by Stichting De Snelle Rakkers. The cross is held around the recreational lake, and the course is entirely unpaved, making it ideal for spikes. There are various distances for youth, the G group, and adults, with prizes in different categories. After the race, participants can enjoy a cup of snert or smoked sausage when they hand in their race number.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course around the recreational lake
Suitable for running in spikes
Start and changing facilities at Zaal en Partycentrum Schoonhoven
additional: Parking and changing facilities are available at Zaal en Partycentrum Schoonhoven. When handing in their race number, participants can choose between a cup of snert and smoked sausage. Prizes are awarded in various age categories and for women and men in different age groups. Registration is open until 7 November. Start and finish at Paviljoen Schoonhoven. The course is suitable for spikes.

description: The Zeijer Strubbenloop takes place in Zeijen for the 15th time on November 8, 2026. The race offers a scenic 5-kilometer route through the Zeijen area, while the 10-kilometer race consists of two laps of this route. The start is at the village green by Café Hingstman. The 10-kilometer race is part of the Univé Loopcircuit De Kop van Drenthe, with prizes for the fastest women and men in both the 5- and 10-kilometer races. The day begins with kids’ runs for different age groups and ends with the awards ceremonies indoors at Café Hingstman.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route through the scenic Zeijen area
10-kilometer race consists of two laps of the 5-kilometer route
Start and finish at the village green by Café Hingstman
additional: On-the-day registration is available between 11:00 and 13:30 at Café Hingstman; cash only. Race numbers will be available at the race office and will not be sent out. The kids’ run starts at 12:30 in different age groups; the 5- and 10-kilometer races start at 14:00. The awards ceremony takes place indoors at Café Hingstman. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl until November 8; start and finish at Café Hingstman.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
price_range: €4-€20 per race of voor het hele seizoen
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually in Zeewolde and organized by TVZ Zeewolde. The event offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometers, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. It attracts both recreational and dedicated runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes around the RCN camping area. The Flevo Fun Run is a great opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy running together in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 10 km distance consists of 2 laps of 5 km. The 2 km distance consists of 2 laps of 1 km. The Flevo Fun Run is part of a club competition. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the organizer’s Facebook page and photo page. Participants receive a medal, registration is required, and there are several age categories. The event promotes enjoyment of running and community connections.

name: Klaazienaveen SportBOXX Oosterbosrun
location: near Trambrug over de Koning Willem Alexander Kanaal, Klazienaveen, Drenthe, Netherlands

description: The SportBOXX Oosterbosrun, organised by Loopgroep Klazienaveen, is an annual running race held in the autumnal Oosterbos near Klazienaveen. Participants can choose between two distances, 5 km and 10 km, which are clearly marked with arrows and ribbons. The start and finish are near the tram bridge on Meester Ovingstraat. Prizes are awarded to the top senior and veteran runners, with a bonus for breaking the course record.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Oosterbos
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Route marked with arrows and ribbons
additional: Registration is open in advance only, until Saturday 8 November at 18:00; registration on the day is not possible. Children aged 15 and under can take part in the 5 km for free. There are no changing or shower facilities. Participants run at their own risk. Gift vouchers from SportBOXX will be raffled among participants. The start and finish are near the tram bridge at Meester Ovingstraat 87.

name: NSL Nederzandt cross
location: Nederzandt Langevelderslag, Noordwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The NSL NederZandtCross is a challenging running event taking place on Sunday, 8 November 2026, at Nederzandt Langevelderslag. This first edition combines elements of a trail run and a competitive race, with a course through dunes, beach and forest. The event offers three distances: 3.8 km, 10.2 km and 16.6 km. The course consists mainly of unpaved paths and features significant elevation changes. Organised in partnership by NSL and Vrijstaat Nederzandt, the event focuses on challenge and performance, with chip timing.
course_highlights: Course through dunes, beach and forest
Mostly unpaved paths with significant elevation changes
Beach section reminiscent of a trail run
additional: Start times: 11:00 for the middle and long distances, 11:10 for the short distance. Telephone number for information and emergencies during the event: 0613-344747. The first edition of the NSL Nederzandt Cross takes place on 8 November 2026 at Nederzandt Langevelderslag, Noordwijk.

name: Docfacross
description: The Docfacross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in and around Oss. The races are held on beautiful unpaved courses suitable for beginners and experienced runners of all ages. The competition offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere where participants can test themselves against others and enjoy running in nature. The Docfacross takes place on 8 November 2026 and invites everyone to take part in this challenging cross-country race.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Suitable for young and old, beginners and experienced runners
Part of a series of six small-scale cross-country races
additional: The cross-country competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four gives participants a chance to place in the final standings. The races are accessible and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere. No specific start time or price information for the Docfacross is listed on the website. A cross-country competition featuring several small-scale races; registration available via Inschrijven.nl; race on 8 November 2026

name: 15e Scopias Klein Zwitserlandcross
description: The Scopias Klein Zwitserland Cross is an annual cross-country race held in the countryside around Tegelen, near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland. The event is part of the Limbra Cross Competition and offers challenging courses for various categories. New in 2025 is a pilot walking event through the Jammerdal nature reserve, with 6 km and 12 km routes. The organisers create a friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies and extra activities for children.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the countryside around Tegelen, near Speelpark Klein Zwitserland
Walk through the Jammerdal nature reserve, with 6 km and 12 km routes
Part of the Limbra Cross Competition
additional: The award ceremonies for the long and short cross are held separately; the long-cross award ceremony takes place immediately after the short cross starts. Participants can update their details after registering and switch between the long and short cross. No advance registration is required for the walk; participants can register on site. Children can swap toys at special exchange boxes along the route. The race is open to all levels, and on-site registration is available. The event is part of the Limbra Cross Competition and is known for its friendly atmosphere and good facilities.

name: AVH Cross
description: The AV Haarlemmermeer Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in often harsh weather conditions such as frost, mud, rain, and snow. The event is open to everyone and offers several distances, including a 1 km lap for the youngest athletes, a 2.5 km sprint cross for older juniors, and recreational races of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. This cross-country race is a true test of strength, combining technique, speed, and endurance, and is part of the popular RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with mud, grass, and turns
1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances
Held in harsh weather conditions such as frost, rain, and snow
additional: The cross is part of the RunX Haarlem Cross Circuit. Several distances are available for different age groups and ability levels. The event is organized by AV Haarlemmermeer, an athletics club that also offers training groups and trial sessions. No explicit start time or pricing information is listed on the website. The race takes place in Haaksbergen and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. A range of distances is offered, making the event appealing to a broad audience.

name: Thorbecke / KWF run
description: The Thorbecke KWF Run in Zwolle is an annual running event where students, teachers, parents and local residents come together to raise money for cancer research. The event symbolizes cooperation, energy and involvement within the school community. The run is a festive and meaningful activity that helps support the Dutch Cancer Society (KWF Kankerbestrijding).
course_highlights: A gathering of students, teachers, parents and local residents
A running celebration at Thorbecke Scholengemeenschap in Zwolle
An initiative focused on raising money for cancer research
additional: The run is part of a broader KWF initiative in which schools and associations take action against cancer. There is a strong emphasis on creating a personal fundraising page to collect donations and involve the community. The run symbolizes a shared commitment to cancer research and building engagement within the school. The event serves as both a running celebration and a school fundraiser, with the aim of raising money for cancer research. The proceeds increase each year, with recent totals exceeding 17,500 euros.

name: Beachrun Zandvoort
description: The Beachrun Zandvoort is an atmospheric running event held on the beach and through the dunes of Zandvoort. With a beautiful combination of sun, sea and beach, this run offers a unique experience for both recreational and dedicated runners. The route varies between firm and soft sand and winds through the diverse dune landscape, making for a challenging and varied run. The event is ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy nature and the fresh sea air while running.
course_highlights: Run along Zandvoort’s 9-kilometre-long beach
Varied terrain, with both paved and unpaved paths through the dunes
Option to run barefoot through the water or on the firm sand
additional: The run takes place in a varied landscape of beach and dunes, with elevation changes and different types of terrain. An extensive network of paths makes several distances possible. The fresh sea air and the sound of the waves create a unique running experience. Parking is available in several paid car parks, and the event is easily accessible by train and bus. The event offers several routes, including the circuit, the dunes and the beach, and takes place on 22 November 2026.

name: Amersfoort Night Run
description: The Amersfoort Night Run is a new running event taking place on Friday evening, 13 November 2026. During this unique night run, you’ll run through an atmospheric, illuminated city, past light installations, live music and surprising entertainment. The route follows the River Eem and passes through Amersfoort city centre, with views of historic landmarks such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, the Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren and the Koppelpoort. The event combines sport with an immersive experience and is officially timed, making it a genuine race too. After the run, there’s a lively afterparty at the KAdE Café on Eemplein to celebrate your achievement.
course_highlights: An atmospheric, illuminated course through Amersfoort city centre
Past historic landmarks such as the medieval city wall, Monnikendam, the Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren and the Koppelpoort
Entertainment along the route, including live music, bands and light installations

The races take place around the Zegerplas and offer distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as 400 m and 1,000 m youth races on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely free of traffic and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a massage room are also available.

description: The Sterke Start Loop on 15 November 2026 in Zevenhuizen is a running event with distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres. The routes pass through beautiful countryside, alongside water and through wooded areas, mainly on paved surfaces, with unpaved trails also included in the 21 km route. The event offers a unique and varied running experience and supports premature babies. There is also a 1 km Kidsrun with obstacles, symbolising the challenges faced by children born prematurely. The start and finish are at the Willem-Alexanderbaan, where participants and supporters gather for a strong start to the day.

Several distances are available, ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km, to suit different ages and abilities. The race is known for its rugged character, so shoes are guaranteed not to stay clean. Pre-registration is open until 13 November 2026.

The run takes place in the beautiful Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area, between Enschede and Haaksbergen. There are four different distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The start is at 11:00, and participants receive a free refreshment afterwards. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on recreation, with no prize-giving or medals.

Trail run in Buurserzand; registration on the day is possible; no prize-giving or medal; free refreshment afterwards; dogs and wheelchairs are not allowed.

The trail features an adventurous course made mostly of unpaved paths, grass and narrow trails, with enjoying nature at its heart. There are three distances: 19 km, 7.9 km and a 1 km Kids Run. The race is more challenging than a road race and requires good trail shoes or shoes with grip. Free snert is served to participants afterwards.

The event offers an enjoyable and sporty evening, with an atmospheric start and finish area, water stations along the route and at the finish. Teams and companies are also welcome to take part together, with extra options such as running shirts and pasta meals.

Since 2024, the start has been at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, improving accessibility and atmosphere. The Horaloop is an atmospheric and challenging race, with chip timing and a welcoming finish venue at Hoekelum Castle.

Choice of paved cycle paths or unpaved trails

Various distances for different ability levels

name: KLM Curaçao Marathon
location: Corendon Mangrove Beach Resort, Willemstad, Curaçao, Netherlands
description: The KLM Curaçao Marathon takes place on November 28 and 29, 2026, and offers a unique running experience along Curaçao’s beautiful coastline. The routes take participants over iconic bridges such as the Queen Emma pontoon bridge and the Juliana Bridge, one of the highest bridges in the world. Several distances are available, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, suitable for both runners and walkers. The event combines sport with a tropical “runcation” experience, including a pasta party and a festive beach finish.

Cross the Juliana Bridge, 185 feet above sea level
Scenic route along Curaçao’s coastline with several water stations

Varied single tracks through several nature reserves
Start and finish at the wooded Molecaten Landgoed Ginkelduin
additional: Because of the short daylight hours, the UHUT100 Winter is spread over two days, with a 09:00 start on Saturday and Sunday. Participants navigate entirely by GPX and receive refreshments every 10–15 km. The finish is before 17:00 on both days. Children can choose from three distances (400, 800 and 1,200 metres), starting on the athletics track, while adults take part in a 5 km run through the countryside around Bemmel. The Pieten are there to lead the warm-up and run alongside the children, giving the event a festive atmosphere. After the race, there will be a friendly get-together and a prize draw, with great prizes to be won, including a voucher for running shoes. The race is suitable for runners aged 12 and over for the 5 km, and aged 16 and over for the 10.8 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

The distinctive course is flat and sheltered, with the start on Spekkelaan and the finish on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with runners completing one to three laps. Families and the youngest participants can take part in the free 1 km GeZZinsloop, with a medal for everyone afterward. After the finish, runners are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.

name: Urban City Run 053
description: The Urban City Run 053 takes place on December 13, 2026, in Enschede and offers participants a unique 5 km or 7.5 km exploratory run through the city centre. The start and finish are at Performance Factory, and the course takes you past attractive squares, streets and various buildings. This is not a race and there is no timekeeping, so you can enjoy the special moments along the way and take selfies. All participants receive a unique running shirt, which serves as their entry pass and must be worn. After the finish, you can chat together over food and drinks.
course_highlights: Varied course through Enschede city centre, including asphalt, carpet and grass
Run through various buildings and climb several staircases
Start and finish at Performance Factory

Start and finish at Performance Factory, start waves between 09:00 and 10:00, minimum age 12, no showers, luggage storage at your own risk.

name: Wintercross ASV Eibergen
description: The Wintercross ASV Eibergen is a challenging cross-country running event that is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. The race takes place in the beautiful natural area around Eibergen and offers distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The competition encourages runners of all ages to enjoy athletics in a welcoming and sporting environment. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs, ensuring a professional and friendly experience.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km
A natural and challenging cross-country course in Eibergen
Races for youth, seniors and masters
additional: The races start at 10:30 with the 10 km for seniors and masters. This is followed by various youth distances from 1 km to 5 km. The age reference date for youth and masters is the final race and the first race of the competition, respectively. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs from the region. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl, with on-site registration also possible; the event is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held at RCN campsite Zeewolde. It offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both beginners and experienced runners and is organised by TVZ Zeewolde, a sports club with a rich history in multisport and triathlon. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, with an emphasis on having fun and enjoying the event together.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN campsite Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Registration is required; the event takes place during the winter months and is suitable for the whole family.

name: Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestre
description: The Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestrecross is a classic cross-country race organised annually by AVR'69 in Reusel. The technical course features several hills and bends and is located at Burgemeester Willekenslaan. The race attracts a strong field, including many Belgian runners, and is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie. Before the race, there is a fun run open to everyone, starting at 1120 metres. The start and finish are at De Oude Brandtoren in Reusel.
course_highlights: Technical course with several hills
Plenty of bends
Located on Burgemeester Willekenslaan in Reusel
additional: Start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren, Burgemeester Willekenslaan 2, Reusel. The cross is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie, a series of 7 cross-country races in region 14 (Kempen). Medals are awarded to the first 3 participants in each race category. The short cross has 2 categories: Men and Women. Pupils without a competition licence or club membership may take part and can also reach the podium. Registration on the day of the race is not possible. Course with hills and bends; registration until 12 December; start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren; various categories, including a fun run for all ages.

name: Santa Run
description: The Rotary Santa Run is a fun run where participants dress as Santa Claus and run or walk a course of approximately 3 kilometres for charity. The event was launched in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon, with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and a few abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were held in 58 cities, raising a combined total of more than €450,000 for over 100 good causes. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform look and a powerful mass start on the Saturday before Christmas.
course_highlights: Short and simple course of approximately 3 km
Participants dressed as Santa Claus
Uniform nationwide look with simultaneous starts
additional: The Rotary Santa Run is organised by local Rotary Clubs, with support from a starter package that includes Santa suits, medals, race numbers, promotional materials and an online registration module. Each location has a minimum of 240 participants, and the event is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organisation is a turnkey concept, with an operations manual, an emergency plan and a uniform look. Participants dress as Santa Claus and support good causes; the event takes place in multiple cities and has a strong focus on charity and community spirit.

name: Avondkerstloop
description: The Avondkerstloop is a festive and sporty evening run held annually on the Saturday before Christmas in the illuminated village of Nispen. The unique start is inside the church on Kerkplein, after which participants run through atmospheric, illuminated streets. There are several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km and 10 km, with medals for all finishers and prizes for the fastest runners. The organizers provide changing rooms, hot showers and a convivial prize ceremony at Café De Gouden Leeuw.
course_highlights: Start inside the church on Kerkplein
Run through the atmospheric, illuminated streets of Nispen
Finish on Kerkplein

Changing rooms and hot showers are available at Sportpark de Wallen. Free parking is available in Nispen. Weekly group training sessions take place on Saturdays at 8:30 and Sundays at 9:00, starting from the open-air theatre. There is a maximum of 250 participants per distance. Start and registration at Café De Gouden Leeuw; training on Saturdays and Sundays; prizes for the fastest runners; facilities such as changing rooms and showers.

name: Gaasterlân Run
description: The Gaasterlân Run is a running event in Balk, Friesland, taking place on Saturday, December 19, 2026. The race offers four distances: 7.5 km, 12 km, a half marathon, and a full marathon. The routes pass through the beautiful, flat Gaasterland countryside, with the start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk. The organizers provide aid stations along the course and use chip timing for accurate results. The Gaasterlân Run is a popular event that offers a rewarding challenge for runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Routes through the flat, wooded Gaasterland countryside
Start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk
Aid stations: 1 for the 12 km, 2 for the half marathon, 4 for the full marathon

description: The Capelle Two-Day Walk 2026 is being organised for the 31st time by the Rotterdam Walking Association. The event takes place on Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 December in the beautiful surroundings of Capelle aan den IJssel. A range of distances is available, from 5 to 35 kilometres, with different routes each day. The walk is a great opportunity to get some fresh air and enjoy nature in December. The start is at the canteen of korfball club KCC, which opens at 8:00 a.m.; the walk starts from 9:00 a.m.

Rest stops are included on all routes

There is a special medal with a pin for participants in both days. Discounts are available for groups and members; starts from 8:00 a.m.; start times are between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m.; routes are available for one or two days; rest stops are included on all routes.

name: Hollands Duin Ultra
description: The Hollands Duin Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through the protected Hollands Duin nature reserve on the coast near Noordwijk. The route takes you through dunes and along the beach, with sandy paths and elevation changes that make the course extra challenging. The start and finish are at Vrijstaat Nederzandt, a welcoming venue right on the beach. There are three aid stations during the race, and all participants receive a tracker for live tracking. This ultra is part of the Dutch Ultra Series and offers a wonderful experience of the area’s natural beauty.

Aid stations at 17 km, 29 km, 40 km and 45 km
Start and finish at Vrijstaat Nederzandt by the beach

No plastic cups are available; participants must bring their own cup/bottle or can purchase a Trail Running Racecup from the organizers. Race registration is open from 08:00 to 09:00. Route through dunes and along the beach, unpaved paths, medal, live tracking, participation in Racecup Trailrunning, maximum capacity of 905 participants

Hoonhorst, the race follows mostly unpaved paths past historic estates and through varied woodland and meadows. With several distances, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from recreational to competitive. This race is a regular fixture in the Sallands Cross Circuit and offers a sporty, sociable way to run toward the end of the year.

The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The half marathon consists of two laps, passing the square twice. The event is organised with the help of service club Tafelronde 168 and athletics club A.V. Flevo Delta, and is open to everyone, including people who are not members of an athletics club. The finish village at Meerpaalplein offers a welcoming place with activities and food and drink for participants and visitors.

description: The Kerstcross Opmeer is a sporting and atmospheric cross-country running event held annually on Boxing Day in Opmeer. With a rich tradition and more than 2,200 participants, young and old, the Kerstcross offers challenging courses beside the VVS’46 grounds, with the start and finish on the A-field. The race is part of the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap and is known for its warm atmosphere, professional chip timing, and personal touch, with names printed on race numbers. After the event, all participants receive a memento and can watch the finish video online.

The prize-giving takes place outdoors immediately after the finish, on the A-field grandstand. All 800-meter runners receive a water bottle at the finish. Hot showers and changing rooms are available. Dogs are not allowed on the land. Participants can choose from various distances from 3.5 km to 27 km, including a special kids’ run and a paraloop for athletes with disabilities. name: Kerstloop Amstelveen
description: The Kerstloop Amstelveen is a festive running race held in the beautiful Amsterdamse Bos. The routes are mostly traffic-free and offer an enjoyable running experience for young and old alike. With distances of 2.5 km for youth, 5 km for fast runners, and a headline distance of 10 km, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. After the race, all participants receive a medal and can enjoy a fresh oliebol. Organizers AV Startbaan and Roda Conditie warmly welcome everyone for an active and enjoyable day.

name: 33e Physique 3de Kerstdagloop
description: The Physique Derde Kerstdagloop in Arnhem is a scenic running race held on Sunday, 27 December 2026. The main event is the 21.1 km half marathon, known as one of the most beautiful and toughest half marathons in the Netherlands, with a challenging course through forests and heathland. There are also 14 km and 7 km distances, which run partly on unpaved paths and hilly terrain. The race is organised at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen and offers facilities such as changing rooms, showers and secure baggage storage. Timing uses the Ipico system, and there are water stations on the longer distances.

14 km route with more than 50% unpaved paths and a fast start over hills and avenues

additional: Changing rooms, showers and free secure baggage storage are available. First aid is available. Volunteers are members of Ciko’66. The finish is on the Ciko’66 track. Routes through forests and heathland, car-free cycle paths, changing rooms, first aid, sports massages, limited parking; public transport is recommended.

The organizers provide a well-organized and safe race environment for all participants.

A popular end-of-year running event with more than 1,000 participants
A varied course suitable for runners and walkers
additional: The Oudejaarsloop draws large numbers of runners and walkers. Results from previous editions are available online via an external link. Photos of the event are shared on local news and blog sites. The organization is part of AV Aquilo, which also organizes other running events in the region. Course updates, registration from 10:00 a.m., participation includes prizes, and pacers for different speeds.

description: The Drenthe Trail Run is a winter trail run taking place on 29 December 2026 in Norg. Participants can choose from three distances: 7, 18 or 26 kilometres, which wind through the forests, heathland and unpaved trails of Drenthe. The event celebrates experiencing nature, adventure and a friendly atmosphere, with a varied course suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are in Norg, and time slots are used to ensure the course remains calm and safe.
course_highlights: A varied course through forests, sandy roads and trails
Routes of 7, 18 and 26 km through Drenthe’s most beautiful natural areas
A winter trail focused on nature and adventure
additional: Time slots are used for each distance to keep the course calm and safe. Participants receive individual timekeeping and have their first name printed on their race bib. Aid stations offer snacks, sports nutrition and water; participants are asked to bring their own cup for sustainability reasons. First aid and technical support are available at the start/finish. After the finish, there will be food, drinks, music and a friendly atmosphere. A bag-drop area is available for dry clothes. Trail shoes are recommended. Registration opens on 17 June 2023 at 08:00, with time slots used to ensure safety and keep the course calm. The event highlights outdoor adventure, respect for nature and a friendly atmosphere.

description: The Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Run is a unique evening race in the atmospherically lit Soester Dunes. Participants can choose to run up to three laps of 1,300 metres each through a beautifully decorated forest and dune area, following the official Sylvestercross course. The finish is at the familiar location, offering a preview of the big Sylvestercross day. Alongside the run, there is also a Family Run for children and a walking tour, making the event suitable for the whole family. Get ready for a magical evening full of fun and a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through a beautifully lit forest and dune area
Official Sylvestercross course
Finish at the familiar location in the Soester Dunes
additional: Participants can order an LED foam stick when registering and collect it along with their race number. The walking tour starts at 18:30 and is one lap of 1.3 km. The Family Run is specifically for children aged 5 to 15 and starts at 19:00. The course is difficult to navigate with strollers and walkers. The run offers a magical evening, with various experience points along the course. Decorations, optional foam stick, registration with the option to enter the originality prize, start and finish in the dunes, donation to the Prinses Maxima Centrum Foundation.

name: AH Oudejaars Crossloop Vorden
location: Het Grote Veld, Vorden, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The AH Oudejaars Crossloop in Vorden takes place on Wednesday, December 30, and offers a scenic run along the forest trails and sandy paths of the Het Grote Veld nature reserve. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 km, and there is a special 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4 to 12. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere, with coffee, tea, and oliebollen after the race, and prizes in various categories. Registration is open until December 27 at 18:00, after which participants will receive their race numbers.
course_highlights: Run along forest trails and sandy paths in the Het Grote Veld nature reserve
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 km available
A 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4–12
additional: The entry fee includes coffee or tea and an oliebol after the race. Kids’ cross participants receive squash drink, an oliebol, and a medal. The race number with a timing chip is emailed the day before the race and can be collected up to half an hour before the start. Registration on race day is not possible. Registration is open from mid-September until December 27 at 18:00. The event attracts many participants from the region and is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Oudjaarsrun
description: On 31 December 2026, LSV Invictus will organize the second edition of the Oudjaarsrun in Appelscha, a sporting event to end the year actively. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The course is fully paved and runs through the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park, with the start and finish in the center of Appelscha. After the finish, there will be an opportunity to celebrate the sporting year with music and a convivial atmosphere in the Steegdenhal.
course_highlights: Fully paved course
Run through Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in the center of Appelscha, on Boerestreek
additional: Bib pickup and the awards ceremony will take place in the Steegdenhal. After the event, there will be a festive gathering with music and a convivial atmosphere. Ample parking is available for participants and visitors. Start times are 11:00 and 11:10. Parking is available at Pretpark Duinenzathe and in the center of Appelscha. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. Festive gathering in the Steegdenhal.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.
course_highlights: 4-mile and 10 km courses through Gorredijk with aid stations
Low-traffic route with traffic marshals for safety
Kids’ run with distances of 600m, 900m and 1600m for different age groups
additional: Kids’ run start times: 600m at 10:45, 900m at 11:00, 1600m at 11:15. 10 km starts at 12:05, 4 miles at 12:20. Business run available for teams of 3–5 participants; finishing time is based on the first 3 finishers. No race-day registration. Register online until 30 December at 22:00 or until the limit is reached. Entries in October and November receive a free Craft Oliebollen running shirt. Bib transfers are possible via the platform until 13 December at 23:59. Registration is online until 30 December; no race-day registration is available. Start times are around 12:00, with the start location at Sportcentrum Kortezwaag. Parking advice: cycle or carpool; road closure from 11:00.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest, through dunes and woodland
Four different loops ranging from 400 metres to 3,300 metres
New Sylvester Trail Run of 21.5 km along the former forest marathon course
additional: The Sylvestercross includes various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a relay cross-country race and a G-cross. The relay cross-country race is a team event with 4 participants, each running one 1,900-metre loop. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

name: Tankloop Westkapelle
location: De Tank, Zeedijk, Westkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The Tankloop Westkapelle is a running event held annually on the dike in Westkapelle. The race offers a unique experience along the coastline, with a challenging course suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The Dynamica Sport organizers welcome participants of all levels for a sporting end to the year. You can easily register via the registration link provided.
course_highlights: Run along the sea dike in Westkapelle
Unique coastal course with beautiful views
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: Register via inschrijven.nl; participant list available; invitation available as an attachment; Dynamica members receive a discount on the entry fee when registering in advance. Paved terrain, registration open until 29 December at 23:59, start and finish at ‘De Tank’ on the Zeedijk, first aid available, no showers available

name: Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.

Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit

First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. name: De Nieuwjaarsloop

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres

You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route

The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.

Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

The race attracts athletes from the region and offers a challenging course through the city of Goes. The organisers provide a sporting and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The Wallenloop is an important event on the Zeeland running calendar and is known for its good organisation and enthusiastic participants.

Atmospheric winter race in January

description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.

Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition

Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.

Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races

The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country running experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The competition encourages participation in multiple races, with points based on the best performances of the season.

Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest trails, meadows and sandy stretches
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners

The organizers place great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in poor weather conditions, as happened recently because of slippery conditions and low feels-like temperatures. name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. The organizers provide electronic timing, and showers are available after the race.

Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres

Weather conditions may affect the race. Prizes consist of cash and gift vouchers.

The run is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes. The Flevo Fun Run is part of TVZ Zeewolde’s activities and attracts runners from the region.
