name: Hulst by Lightrun
description: Hulst by Lightrun is a friendly running and walking event held in Hulst. It takes place on the third Friday evening of every month and offers a sociable atmosphere for participants of different levels. The route winds through Hulst’s charming streets, making it a unique experience for runners and walkers. It’s an accessible event that combines sport and conviviality.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes through Hulst’s charming streets
Friendly, relaxed atmosphere
Monthly event on the third Friday evening
additional: The event takes place on the third Friday evening of every month. It is an accessible running and walking event with a sociable atmosphere. A friendly running and walking event, held every third Friday evening.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum 300 participants per race. Timing without a chip. No showers or changing rooms available. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos will be published after the race. Course on unpaved paths; no showers or changing rooms; maximum 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area
additional: There is a €100 cash prize for breaking the course record. The official 10 km course records are 30.59 for men and 35.43 for women. The event lasts approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes. The route passes hunebeds and includes forest and road sections. Registration is available in advance and on the day. Prizes are offered for breaking the course record.

name: Zuurbergcross
description: The Zuurbergcross is a challenging cross-country race organised by Atletiekvereniging Holten and part of the SNS CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37, in Holten. The varied course includes a few crossings over paved roads and a short stretch of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge. There is ample parking, first aid is available, and a speaker adds to the atmosphere during the event.
course_highlights: Course with a few crossings over paved roads
Around 500 metres of brick paving, which can be avoided by running along the verge
Start and finish at the MAC Stuurhuus, Beusebergerweg 37
additional: Ample parking, first aid and a speaker are available during the event. Participation is entirely at your own risk. The course is suitable for spikes and includes a few crossings over paved roads and brick paving that can be avoided. The race takes place in Beuseberg, Holten, and offers practical facilities including registration at the MAC Stuurhuus, parking, first aid and sound equipment.

description: The Bosmarathon & Minder is a running event in Assen featuring a full marathon and several shorter distances. The routes run mostly along unpaved paths through the Asserbos, a woodland area of approximately 100 hectares. The start, refreshments and finish are at the AAC'61 athletics track. The lap is just over 7 km, with six laps making up the full marathon. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink, and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Route mostly along unpaved paths in the Asserbos
Start, refreshments and finish at the AAC'61 athletics track
Lap of just over 7 km; six laps for the marathon
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl through 15 January, or on the day at the clubhouse, with card payment. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, including water, tea, broth and sports drink. Changing rooms are available at the venue at Achterpad 1, 9405 BN Assen. Participation is at your own risk. Results and photos will be published afterwards on the club page. Unpaved paths, registration in advance and on the day, changing rooms available.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplasgebied, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a series of three running races held in November, January and February around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races offer running distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as special youth distances of 400 and 1,000 metres on the athletics track. There are also walking distances of 5 and 10 km, starting at the same time as the 20 km running race. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a canteen are also available. The race features official timing and a nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas.
course_highlights: Nearly traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
A range of distances for beginner and experienced runners, including youth races on the track
additional: There is a 2-hour time limit for the walking distances. There is a drinks station on the track for participants in the 15 and 20 km races on their second lap. A free massage is available afterwards in the AAV'36 massage room (bring your own towel). Youth race keepsakes are free; other keepsakes and stamp cards for taking part in all three races are available for a fee. First aid is available on the track and course. The canteen is open and a limited number of lockers are available. Distances for runners and walkers; course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas; traffic-free course; start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track; changing rooms and showers available; free leg massage by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn.

name: Goedhart Drechtloop
location: Leimuiden, Kaag en Braassem, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Goedhart Drechtloop has been organized annually since 1969 by Vereniging S.V. Kickers ‘69 on the third Sunday in January. The event offers several distances: a 1.4 km children’s run, 4 km, 10 km and 10 English miles. The route passes through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude and along the Drecht, offering a scenic and varied running experience in the Groene Hart.
course_highlights: Run through the villages of Leimuiden and Rijnsaterwoude
Route along the Drecht river
Varied course in the rural Groene Hart
additional: The start and finish are on Beukenlaan in Leimuiden. The event runs from 11:00 to 14:00. Several distances are available, including a 1.4 km children’s run. The event is organized by S.V. Kickers ‘69. It takes place on 17 January 2027 from 11:00 to 14:00, with several running options and a convivial atmosphere for participants of all ages.

name: Leemkuilcross
location: Berg en Dal, Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: Kind- en jeugdcross: € 3,5; Korte- en lange cross: € 7; Na-inschrijving: € 5 en € 10
description: The Leemkuilcross is one of the most beautiful cross-country races in the Netherlands, organised by NSAV ’t Haasje and AV Cifla. It takes place on a hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal and is known for its challenging nature, particularly the notorious staircase. The race offers several distances for children, young people and adults, and attracts athletes who enjoy a tough cross-country race. Race bibs can be collected at the Berg en Dal tennis club, and parking is limited. The Leemkuilcross takes place annually on the third Sunday in January.
course_highlights: Hilly, unpaved woodland course in Berg en Dal
Laps around the Leemkuil, with the notorious staircase as a challenge
Distances ranging from 1200m to 8400m
additional: Race bibs can be collected in the canteen of the Berg en Dal tennis club, Molenbosweg 10. Parking is limited. Late registration is possible until just over half an hour before the start of the relevant race, at a higher cost. Prize ceremonies take place immediately after each event. Cancellations are possible up to one week before the event, subject to an administration fee. The course is a hilly, unpaved woodland route with the notorious staircase; registration is possible until one week before the event; prices include registration fees and late registration is available.

name: Watermolenloop
description: The Watermolenloop in Haaksbergen is a popular running race that attracts many sports enthusiasts every year. The race takes place in a welcoming setting, with a varied course that runs through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen. The 2026 edition drew enthusiastic runners early in the morning, despite the chilly weather, which only added to the sporting atmosphere. The event is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH) and is a great opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: A varied course through nature and past distinctive places in Haaksbergen
A welcoming start at Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH)
A traditional event with a sporting and friendly atmosphere
additional: The Watermolenloop is organised by Atletiekvereniging Haaksbergen (AVH). The event takes place in January and attracts a wide range of runners. It has a sporting and friendly atmosphere, even in cold weather. The race is part of Haaksbergen’s local sporting activities. The Watermolenloop draws sports enthusiasts to Haaksbergen and is known for a route past the Oostendorper Watermill and through the Lankheterbos, with support from volunteers and safety services.

name: De Kievitloop Januari 2027
location: Bergen op Zoom, North Brabant, Netherlands

name: Duin Strandloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, with varied courses combining challenging dune trails and fast beach sections. The Duin/Strandloop on 23 January 2027 offers a great atmosphere for both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to enjoy running outdoors. The races are suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from kids’ runs to 10 km. The series encourages participation with a ranking based on each runner’s best four results.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Kids’ runs and longer distances up to 10 km
Unique coastal setting with beautiful nature and challenging terrain
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids’ Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids’ Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids’ Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results in the series. Courses, rankings, start times, results

description: The Gewoon COOP Crossloop in Luttenberg is a popular, traditional cross-country race and part of the Sallands Cross Circuit. Since 1976, participants have run through the forests and hills of Luttenberg on a challenging course that is largely unpaved and includes steep climbs, including the famous climb to the bench. Combining a unique atmosphere, a demanding course and a rich history, the race offers an unforgettable experience for all ages.
course_highlights: Course is 70% unpaved
Notorious climb to the famous bench
Route through forests and over hills, with views of the Sallandse Heuvelrug
additional: Race bibs are personal for the entire season and must be brought to every race. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. Participants receive a unique Sallands Cross Circuit running shirt when they register. The cross-country race features several distances, with start times between 10:45 and 12:40. The start and finish are at Gemeenschapscentrum Elckerlyc, Butzelaarstraat 22. The event offers various distances for all ages, including a final stretch past the Lourdes grotto. The event is sponsored by Charlot Jalink of Gewoon Coop and has a strong community atmosphere.

name: Halve Marathon Zoetermeer
description: The Halve Marathon Zoetermeer is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 24 January 2027. The 14th edition offers four distances: the 1.5 km Kids Run, 5 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The routes pass through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark, Balijbos, and the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker, on a fast, straightforward course. The event is suitable for all ages, with a special focus on school competitions and a business run for teams.
course_highlights: Routes through Burgemeester Hoekstrapark and Balijbos
Course through the municipalities of Zoetermeer and Pijnacker
Clear, colour-coded kilometre markers for each distance
additional: Running shirts can be ordered for €12.50 each and collected on Saturday, 23 January, between 15:00 and 17:00, or on Sunday, 24 January, from 10:00. There is a school competition for the 1.5 km Kids Run and a business run for teams in the 5 km. The half marathon has mandatory time cut-offs at certain points on the course to allow roads to be reopened to traffic. Parking arrangements are in place, and volunteers are being sought for the event. Multiple distances, registration details, running shirts available to order, a colour-coded course, and timing and pace limits for the half marathon.

name: Safari Trail - rond Burgers' Zoo Arnhem
Midwintercross Heeten
location: Sportpark SV Heeten, Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Midwintercross in Heeten is a regional cross-country race that is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and is organised by SV Heeten. The 54th edition takes place on Sunday, 3 January 2027, at Sportpark SV Heeten. The course runs through the sports park and the woods around Schoonheten, with approximately 70 per cent unpaved terrain and gentle elevation changes. The routes offer green landscapes and wooded sections, and the prize winners are honoured in an annual ceremony after the race. The Midwintercross has a long history and has become a regular cross-country race in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the sports park and woods around Schoonheten
Approximately 70% unpaved terrain with gentle elevation changes
Green landscapes and wooded sections along the route
additional: The Midwintercross offers several distances. The 6 km and 10 km routes were revised in 2024. There is an annual prize-giving ceremony after the race. After the race, there is a prize-giving ceremony and a friendly atmosphere, with registration open to participants.

name: Rondje Roege Baarg
description: Rondje Roege Baarg is an atmospheric cross-country run and walking event organised by Hardloopclub Onstwedde in collaboration with Stichting Wandelen in Westerwolde. The running routes range from 6.4 to 22.8 kilometres and pass through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, including Ter Wupping, Veele and Wessinghuizen. Walkers can enjoy a marked 10-kilometre route with a refreshment station. The start and finish are at MFA de Bast in Onstwedde, which also has changing and shower facilities. After the event, participants can enjoy delicious snert from slagerij Hemmen.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the beautiful Westerwolde countryside, with routes of 6.4, 11.3, 18.9 and 22.8 km
Three refreshment stations along the route for runners
10 km walking route marked with yellow arrows, with one refreshment station
additional: Start and finish at MFA de Bast, with changing and shower facilities. Manual timekeeping; results available via uitslagen.nl. Dogs are not allowed. Snert is served to all participants after the event. Walkers can start between 10:30 and 11:30. Walkers can get their walking book stamped. An emergency phone number is available for walkers. Walking route of 10 km; running distances from 6.4 km to 22.8 km; start and finish at MFA De Bast; changing and shower facilities; advance registration open until 24 January; participation at your own risk; dogs are not allowed.

name: 19e Rhoonse Griendentocht
description: The 19th Rhoonse Grienden Tour is a beautiful walking tour that takes place in Rhoon on Saturday, January 30. Organized by the Royal Dutch Walking Association (KWbN), it gives walkers the opportunity to enjoy a healthy and rewarding walking experience in beautiful surroundings. The tour is suitable for both beginners and experienced walkers and promotes physical activity and well-being.
course_highlights: Walk through the Rhoon nature reserve and surrounding area
Options to take part on two days
Discover local landscapes and historic surroundings
additional: Participants who want to take part on both days can register for both days using the form: first register for Saturday, then use “+ add participant” to register for Sunday as well. Wandel.nl is an initiative of KWbN, the Netherlands’ largest walking organization, which inspires and supports walkers. Two-day participation, registration forms, membership discounts

name: Rondje Oeken
location: De Vroolijke Frans, Brummen, Gelderland, Netherlands
price_range: geen grote inschrijfgelden, mogelijk kleine kosten voor inschrijving
description: Rondje Oeken is a welcoming, small-scale running event held in the beautiful countryside around Oeken and Brummen. The route passes along rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths, and is fully marked and largely traffic-free. The event is open to all levels, from beginners to keen runners, and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The start and finish are at De Vroolijke Frans in Brummen, where ample parking is also available.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery with rural roads, woodland edges and quiet paths
Fully marked and largely traffic-free course
Start and finish at De Vroolijke Frans, Knoevenoordstraat 51, Brummen
additional: There are two start times: 10:00 for the 21.1 km and 10:30 for the 12 km. Parking is available at De Vroolijke Frans and on the field behind it. You can register using the registration form on the website, either in advance or on the day. The event is welcoming and focused on a friendly atmosphere, sportsmanship and safety, with experienced volunteers and first aid on site. The course varies from unpaved paths to trail; there is a children's run, and registration is available on the day. The start is at De Vroolijke Frans.

name: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop
description: Uithoorns Mooiste De Loop is a welcoming and well-organized running race in Uithoorn, known for its varied and safe course. The race attracts many participants each year, including long-distance runners and children, and is supported by a large group of volunteers and traffic marshals. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and offers a festive day of sport, with a focus on participants and a special anniversary atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and safe course
Special atmosphere and good organization
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The race is supported by around 125 volunteers and more than 50 traffic marshals. Participants are catered for with water stations along the course, fruit and a memento at the finish. At the 40th anniversary, special treats were handed out, including cream cakes and flower bulbs. There are multiple distances, including a children’s race and special categories, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl; the course runs through Uithoorn and the surrounding area, with traffic marshals and measures to minimize disruption.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances ranging from 1.4 to 15 kilometers
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; late registration is available on race day from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at Semmelweisstraat 46, IKC De Wooldermarke. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday between 3:00 and 5:00 p.m. or on race day. The race number includes a timing chip and is valid for all four races. Shower and changing facilities are available in the small sports hall on Woolderesweg, which closes at 1:15 p.m. A running shirt and medal can optionally be ordered during pre-registration and collected with the race number or after the finish. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Bringing pets, strollers, etc. is not allowed. Participants can register for different distances, with the start and finish at Woolderes. The event offers prizes such as cash and gift vouchers. The race takes place on 31 January 2027 and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

description: The Hoessenbosch Cross is part of the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition and takes place near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several junior cross distances. The short and long cross start at 10:00, followed by the junior cross at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is part of a series of cross-country races in the Oss region.
course_highlights: Unpaved course near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Junior cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race. The junior cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition with several events in the Oss region. The location is near the car park of the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem. Start times: 10:00 and 11:10; location near the Hoessenbosch open-air theatre in Berghem

description: The Amersfoortse Bergcross is a challenging cross-country race through hilly woodland with winding sandy paths. The course is unpaved, and one lap is 2.5 kilometres. Participants can choose from several distances by running 1 to 4 laps, making it suitable for both recreational and advanced runners. The start and finish are at the same location, and chip timing is used to record accurate times. The event is exclusively for employees and family members of companies affiliated with Railsport.
course_highlights: Course through hilly woodland with winding sandy paths
Unpaved terrain with one lap of 2.5 km
Start and finish at the same location
additional: Timing uses a chip attached to the shoe; the chip must be returned after finishing. A maximum of 2 guests per employee is allowed. A Railsport Runners shirt can be purchased on the day of the event for € 5,00 and is recommended for sustainability. The location is Stationsplein 299, Amersfoort, in the SOVA Railzicht building. Course through sandy woodland paths, multiple distances, chip timing, location at Stationsplein 299, Amersfoort

description: The Midwinter Marathon in Apeldoorn is a three-day running event held on the first weekend of February. It offers several distances, including a marathon with a unique route through the Natura 2000 area and the Kootwijkerzand, a 10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, and shorter distances such as the Night Run and Kidsrun. The marathon route is partly off-road and passes iconic locations such as Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk. The Midwinter Marathon is known for its welcoming organisation, beautiful natural scenery, and a broad field of participants, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.
course_highlights: Marathon route with 900 metres off-road across the Kootwijkerzand
Route through a Natura 2000 area, passing Apenheul and Radio Kootwijk
10 English Miles through wooded, hilly surroundings, with its highest point at 100 metres above sea level
additional: The marathon starts and finishes at AV’34 in the Orderbos. There is a welcome with coffee or tea and a treat, followed after the race by pea soup with rye bread and bacon, or a vegetarian option. The 10EM starts and finishes on the Loolaan, with changing rooms and showers in nearby gymnasiums. Start corrals for the 10EM are assigned based on expected finish time. The marathon is limited to 700 participants and registration closes once this limit is reached. There is no on-the-day registration. The 10EM has a maximum of 4,200 participants. There are several refreshment stations and medical support. The Midwinter Marathon also offers an app for live runner tracking. Several distances, including the Kidsrun, 8 km and marathon; event in February 2027; registration opens in October 2026.

name: Blaauwbek Marathon
description: The Blaauwbek Marathon is an atmospheric winter marathon around Oldambtmeer in Blauwestad. The half and full marathons start in Bad Nieuweschans and finish at De Rietkraag, with bus transport from the finish to the start. There are also 5 km and 10 km distances that start and finish at De Rietkraag, featuring a unique course across the airfield. In addition to running events, there are 10 km and 20 km walking routes and special distances for children. The organizers provide warm refreshments along the way and a warm welcome at the finish.
course_highlights: Course around Oldambtmeer, with beautiful scenery and trails
Separate start and finish locations, with bus transport for marathon runners
Unique course across the airfield for the 5 km and 10 km distances
additional: The half marathon starts at 11:15 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The full marathon starts at 9:45 with bus transport from De Rietkraag. The finish closes at 16:30 for both marathon distances. Children start the 5 km at 15:30. Walkers can start independently after receiving their route. The event offers various distances, including youth and walking routes, and bus transport for marathon runners. The event returns after several years’ absence and is marked by a winter theme and a convivial atmosphere.

name: Erpelkappersloop
description: The Erpelkappersloop in Axel is a traditional race organized annually by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an enjoyable, sporty experience in beautiful surroundings. It is part of a series of events organized by the club, which is known for its varied and well-organized running activities. The Erpelkappersloop promises a sociable and challenging running experience during the winter season.
course_highlights: Organized in Axel, a charming location
A traditional race with a sporty atmosphere
Part of a series of events organized by Joggingclub Moerbeke-Waas
additional: The race takes place on February 6, 2027, and is aimed at a broad range of runners.

name: Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross
organizer: Loopgroep SGO, Vomos UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug
description: The Gletsjerkuil Ees Cross is a challenging cross-country race set in the unique landscape of the Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark. The race takes place in Ees and offers two distances: a short route of approximately 5 km and a long route of approximately 9 km, both along unpaved paths through woodland and heathland. The route passes along narrow paths, several glacial pits and the storm-damaged forest with fallen trees, making for an adventurous run surrounded by nature. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course, except for two crossings of cycle paths
Route through narrow heathland paths and several challenging glacial pits
Passage through the mysterious storm-damaged forest with fallen trees
additional: The cross is run without chip timing. No shower or changing facilities are available. The start location is Land van Bartje, Buinerweg 8, 9536 PG Ees. Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting on the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. The 21.1 km half-marathon course runs through the cold fields northwest of the city, where the wind has free rein. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, all measured exactly. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through cold fields northwest of Leeuwarden
Precisely measured distances of 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish on the Lionitas athletics track
additional: Start times by distance: 1 km kids’ run at 11:00, 21.1 km at 11:10, 10 km at 11:20, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. Participants can check the route in advance via afstandmeten.nl and download GPX files for sports watches. The Gouden Leeuw race number is valid for this race and Rondje Goutum, includes entry into prize draws and offers the option to purchase a special medal. Terrain: farmland and athletics track; Online registration via afstandmeten.nl; Race on 7 February 2027; Start and finish location at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, Leeuwarden

name: Twentse Vennenloop

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Twentse Ven’n Loop is a small-scale running event held in Twente’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is known for its relaxed atmosphere and unique running experience. In 2027, the event will be held for the eleventh time, offering participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to support a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the event is known for Twentish hospitality.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Twentse countryside
Start and finish at Camping de Meene in Buurse
Small-scale event with a maximum of 250 participants
additional: The maximum number of participants is 250. After costs are deducted, proceeds from entry fees go to a sponsored cause. Participants must follow the rules and the organizers’ instructions. Pets, strollers, and similar items are not allowed. The organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the event in extreme weather conditions. The Road Traffic Act remains in force during the run. Distances: 4.8 km, 10.3 km, 16.2 km; course through nature, wet terrain, facilities at the start/finish, charity initiative

name: AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentine Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods of Het Lageveld recreational park. The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods
Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are maintained for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Varied course with dune trails and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.
course_highlights: Fast, fully paved course through the open polder
Long straight roads and sturdy drainage canal embankments
Start and finish in the middle of Bleskensgraaf
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 08:30 at the meeting area, De Spil. The meeting area also has a cloakroom, toilets, and limited shower facilities. Timing is provided by an Ipico chip in the race number, which measures net running time. There is a drink station at kilometer 8.1 of the 10 English Miles. Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with Melkwegplein and Weideweg preferred. Race-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 has not yet been announced, but the event is popular and sells out quickly. Facilities include parking, first aid, and Ipico timing. There is also an option to donate to a good cause.

name: Dinkelcross
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organized by Iphitos in the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie and offers challenging courses that are entirely off-road, with sandy stretches, tough short hills, and a route along a branch of the River Dinkel. There are several distances for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course through the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area
Crossing a sandy stretch and tackling a few tough short hills
Running along a branch of the Dinkel River
additional: A maximum of 150 race-day entrants can take part; registration on the day is not possible. The start and finish are at the Zaandhoes, accessible from Grensweg. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start times for the various distances and age categories are scheduled between 10:30 and 12:45. The Dinkelcross is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. Off-road course, various distances, start and finish at Zaandhoes, changing rooms and showers available, suitable for all levels.

description: The Noord-Aa Polder Run takes place on Sunday, 14 February 2027, at the Road Runners clubhouse in Zoetermeer. The course runs through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are several distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run and 5, 10 and 15 km races, so everyone can choose a suitable goal. Proceeds from the event go to IKC Het Zwanenbos to support the education and well-being of children in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa
Route past water, open polder landscape and paved paths
A range of distances from 1.5 km to 15 km
additional: Each distance starts at a different time to keep the course clear: 1.5 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:10 and 15 km at 13:20. Registering in advance is recommended to guarantee a starting spot. The event is made possible in part by sponsors; prospective partners can get in touch via the email address provided. The course runs through the polder around Zoetermeerse Plas, not on an athletics track, and is suitable for different ability levels, with a focus on having fun and supporting good causes.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN camping Zeewolde. The event has grown in recent years and attracts runners from the region. It offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere for participants of different levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and website.
course_highlights: Run in the area around RCN camping Zeewolde
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start time of 11:00 for the 5 km and 10 km
additional: The 5 km and 10 km start at 11:00. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the Facebook page and photo page. In previous editions, the 5 km and 10 km filled up quickly, while registration for the 1 km and 2 km remained open until 12:00 on race day. Held on the second Sunday of each month in November, December, January and February at RCN camping Zeewolde. Four distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. Medals for kids and participants taking part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary by distance.

name: Danikerbosloop
description: The Danikerbosloop is an annual running race in Geleen, held for the 19th time in 2027. The race takes place in a wooded area around Daniken and offers distances of 5 km, 5 miles and 10 miles, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. There is also a kids’ run of approximately 1.2 km for children up to 13 years old. The start and finish are at Manege Ten Eysden, where refreshments are also available.
course_highlights: Wooded surroundings on the outskirts of Geleen
Course with a short approach loop followed by 1, 2 or 4 large laps
Start and finish at Manege Ten Eysden
additional: On-site registration is available from 09:00 at Manege Ten Eysden; cash payment only. When collecting their race bib, participants receive two vouchers: one for a drink and one for a piece of Limburg vlaai. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in all distances except the Kids’ Run, where every child receives a prize. Online pre-registration is available from 1 December until one week before the event; on-site payment is in cash. Participants receive a drink and Limburg vlaai when collecting their race bib. The Kids’ Run starts at 10:00.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, held around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Refreshment stations are available on the longer distances, with water at the finish.
course_highlights: Almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
Official timing by MyLaps and refreshment stations on the longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 5 and 10 km walking distances. Walkers start at the same time as the 20 km running race. Youth runners have special distances of 400 m and 1000 m on the track, with a free commemorative item. A massage room offers free massages from Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The cafeteria is open, and a limited number of lockers are available. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

description: The Wooldereslopen is a traditional running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year. Distances range from 1.4 to 15 kilometres, and the course runs through the countryside around Hengelo. The start and finish are at the same location in the Woolderes, creating a clear and friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
additional: Electronic timing. Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 a.m. on race day or on the preceding Saturday. T-shirts can be ordered as an optional extra. Shower facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Participation is at your own risk. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. The Wooldereslopen consists of four races held every three weeks during the first months of the year. Participants can enter the 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km and 15 km distances. The organisers emphasise the friendly atmosphere and the course through the countryside around Hengelo.

name: Omloop van Noordwijkerhout
location: Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The HomeWizard Omloop van Noordwijkerhout is a welcoming running event held in the beautiful dune area and among the colourful bulb fields around Noordwijkerhout. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a 1 km family run. The half marathon takes you through woodland and dunes and along paved roads, bringing nature and sport together. The venue is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a bag drop. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes looking to enjoy a challenging and varied course.
course_highlights: Half marathon through dunes and flowering bulb fields
5 km and 10 km on fully paved roads alongside colourful bulb fields
Varied course through woodland, dunes and nature
additional: Start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout. Changing rooms, shower facilities and a bag drop are available. Parking is available at several nearby locations, but cycling is preferred. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit, with an attractive overall standings competition and prizes in every category. Course through dunes and bulb fields; registration via the website; start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst.

description: The Rondje Strand TIEN Cross is the final race of the AV Oss ’78 Cross Competition 2025-2026, held on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several youth cross distances. The venue is Strand TIEN at Gielekespad 10 in Oss, where runners can enjoy an off-road course. The short and long cross start at 10:00, and the youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Off-road course at Strand TIEN in Oss
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Youth cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race via the registration link. The youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition featuring multiple races in Oss and the surrounding area. There is an overall ranking for participants who take part in at least four races. Venue: Gielekespad 10 in Oss; registration closes 30 minutes before the race; courses of approximately 5 km and 10 km.

name: Berden Voorjaarsloop
description: The Berden Voorjaarsloop in Venlo is a sporting event taking place on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a wide range of distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 15 kilometres for experienced runners. A special feature is that participants in the 7.5 km and 15 km races run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track, adding a unique experience. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities and offers a fresh, energetic start to spring.
course_highlights: The 7.5 km and 15 km routes run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track
Safe and clearly laid-out courses past College Den Hulster and along Hagerhofweg
Routes through green surroundings, including the petting zoo and Vrijenbroek sports park
additional: Start times range from 10:40 to 14:05, depending on the distance. There is ample bicycle parking at College Den Hulster and parking at Fontys. Parents may run alongside the youngest participants. Refreshment stations are available, and all finishers receive a medal. Distances range from 500 metres to 15 km, including youth races and a race on a professional athletics track; registration via inschrijven.nl; event in Venlo.

name: 3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is an atmospheric running race in Driebergen, with three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The routes follow unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways through the beautiful Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates. The race is known for its scenic, demanding courses and its focus on sustainability, with participants encouraged to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the way and at the finish. The organizers provide a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways
Half marathon through the Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates
Refreshment stations with water and sports drink along the route and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are sent to the home address provided. Start and finish at RCN Het Grote Bos. Refreshments at 9 km, 15 km and after the finish for the half marathon; at 4 km and after the finish for the 10 km; and after the finish for the 6 km. No medals are awarded. Racetimer chip timing is included. Race numbers can be transferred via the registration website. Participants are encouraged to use their own reusable cups to support sustainability. Routes have been adjusted due to area restrictions; registration opens in early December 2026; options are available to transfer race numbers and volunteer; the event takes an environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing is included.

name: ACO van Elderen Crossloop
description: The ACO Van Elderen Crossloop is a challenging cross-country race organised by athletics club ACO Van Elderen in Ommen. The race is part of the Prins Sport-Vechtdalcrosscompetitie and takes place in the nature area around Ommen. The race starts on the athletics track, after which the course runs mostly off-road through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural surroundings and varied course.
course_highlights: Start on the athletics track
Course runs mostly off-road through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)
additional: Registration is online only and open until 4 March 2027; no on-the-day registration is available. A lead cyclist will ride ahead of the runners during the race. For the 5 km and 10 km, day prizes are awarded to the first three women and men, provided by sponsors. For the youth distance (1.75 km), prizes are awarded to the first three in each category. Forest course, off-road terrain, online registration until 04-03-2027, prizes for the top three and course record

name: Halve Marathon van Haren
description: The RunX Haren Half Marathon is a spring classic, taking place for the 42nd time on Saturday, March 6, 2027, in Haren, Groningen. The event offers a sporty and enjoyable day, with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km recreational runs. The half marathon starts at 11:00 a.m. and the recreational runs at 11:20 a.m. By taking part, you support Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen, which helps children from families with limited means join sports or cultural clubs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sporthal Scharlakenhof in Haren
Route through the Felland Zuid industrial estate, 1,000 meters from the finish
Strict time limit of 2.5 hours for the half marathon
additional: Race numbers will be sent by post at the end of February 2026. Changes to distance or participant can be submitted online until March 6, 2026, at 10:00 p.m., for a fee of €2.50. Medals are optional and cost an additional €2.50. The half marathon has a time limit of 150 minutes. The Road Traffic Act applies on the course. Registration opens on October 24, 2026; various routes are available for different levels; the event supports Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen.

name: Rondje Zwolle Marathon
description: Rondje Zwolle 2027 is the second edition of a small-scale marathon around the beautiful city of Zwolle, organised by Zwolselopers. The marathon is all about camaraderie, running together and enjoying the experience, without an emphasis on fast times or personal records. Participants can run the full marathon or sign up together and split the distance. Weekend long runs are organised to help participants train together. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe supports participants in getting fit for the start.
course_highlights: Marathon around the city of Zwolle
Small-scale event with a friendly atmosphere
Option to split the distance and take turns running together
additional: The marathon is intentionally small-scale, with a limited number of race entries. Friendly weekend long runs are organised in preparation. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe is a sponsor and provides support with injuries. The start is at Wijthmenerplas. The marathon is characterised by an informal atmosphere and training and running together with other participants.

name: 65 van Walcheren
description: The 65 van Walcheren is a challenging 65-kilometre ultrarun held in Westkapelle. Made possible in part by De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen, it is known as the most beautiful and toughest ultrarun in the region. The route takes participants past some of Walcheren’s most beautiful places and is open to both runners and walkers. The event is organised by dedicated volunteers and supports Stichting Roparun, which supports projects for people with cancer.
course_highlights: A 65-kilometre ultrarun through the best of Walcheren
Open to both runners and walkers
Organised with care for the region and participants
additional: The event is organised in support of the charity Stichting Roparun. De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen is the title sponsor. Registration is linked to a crowdfunding platform where participants can raise money. There is a special shirt design for 2027. The event is open to both runners and walkers. It takes place on 7 March 2027 and attracts participants from the region and beyond. Results from previous years are also available on the website.

description: The Fysio 0512 Run Drachten is a running event held in Drachten, starting and finishing on the athletics track at AV Impala. The 10 km race is the official Open Frisian Championship and takes place on a unique, certified course through the beautiful countryside around Drachten. There are also 5 km and 1.5 km kids’ run distances, making the event suitable for runners of all levels and ages. The race combines a sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes for the top runners and club champions.
course_highlights: The 10 km is the official Open Frisian Championship
Certified, fast course through the countryside around Drachten
Start and finish on the athletics track at AV Impala
additional: Collect race bibs on 8 March from 9:30 at the AV Impala clubhouse. No on-the-day registration is possible; online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. Limited changing and shower facilities are available. Free parking in the immediate vicinity of Sportlaan. Prizes for the top men and women in the Open Frisian Championship 10 km and for club champions in the 10 km and 5 km (with an Impala race shirt). All participants in the 1.5 km kids’ run receive a reward. A running clinic for 5 km and 10 km runners takes place before the event, with five training sessions led by coaches. Certified course, open to recreational and competitive runners, advance registration required, no on-the-day registration.

name: Halve van Oostvoorne
location: Oostvoorne, Voorne aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Halve van Oostvoorne is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 7 March 2027, in the lively village centre and the scenic dunes of Oostvoorne. Participants can choose from a half marathon of 21.1 km, a fast 8 km, or youth races of 1 and 2 km. The paved course offers a lovely mix of nature and village scenery, with excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start. Organised by football club OVV and Voorne Atletiek, the event promises a safe, well-run day full of sporting fun.
course_highlights: Paved course through the scenic dunes and village centre
Music and activities for spectators create a festive atmosphere
Excellent facilities, including changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start
additional: The 1 km youth race starts at 11:00 (up to age 11); the 2 km race starts at 11:15 (up to age 14). The 8 km and half marathon start at 12:00. All participants receive a medal. Minimum age: 14 for the 8 km and 16 for the half marathon. Facilities: unguarded changing rooms and showers, parking, and a canteen serving drinks, sandwiches and snacks. Half-marathon course records: men 01:06.36; women 01:17.41. Parking is available close to the start, with several other parking options within walking distance. Paved course; facilities include changing rooms, showers and parking; registration is open.

name: Loopfestein Stein
description: Loopfestein Stein is an annual running race held in Stein, the Netherlands. On Sunday, March 7, 2027, the 32nd edition will take place, featuring various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a youth run. The race is supported by local sponsors and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for runners of all ages. The routes pass through beautiful Stein and are suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Routes through the town of Stein with varied terrain
Youth runs with different distances and start times
Woodhenge Night Run with atmospheric lighting (separate event)
additional: The youth run starts at 10:00, with distances varying by year of birth. The Woodhenge Night Run is a separate event held in June. The event is supported by various local sponsors. The Mijnverleden monument in Stein receives attention during the event. Registration for the 32nd edition is open; the venue and exact registration information are not specifically stated.

name: Rondje Goutum

price_range: Jeugd t/m 15 jaar: € 5,00; 16 Jaar en ouder: € 7,50; 30 km: € 8,50
description: Rondje Goutum is a running event in Leeuwarden that takes you to the south side of the city. It offers a wide range of distances, from a 1 km Kids Run to a challenging 30 km, making it ideal preparation for other races. The distances are measured exactly, and all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate afterwards. The start and finish are at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, where participants in every distance run one more lap of the track on their return.
course_highlights: Exactly measured distances from 1 km to 30 km
Start and finish at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, with a lap of the track
Aid stations and first aid available, including on the 10 km route
additional: Start times by distance: 30 km at 10:30, 1 km Kids Run at 11:00, 16 km at 11:15, 10 km at 11:25, 5 km at 11:35, and 2 km at 11:40. Registration is online only and remains open until shortly before the start; on-site registration is not available. Routes are available via afstandmeten.nl, with GPX, KML, and TCX downloads. All participants receive hot chocolate afterwards. Participants can register online only. The event takes place at Atletiekbaan Nijlân / Lionitas, Middelzeelaan 20, Leeuwarden.

distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1.25 km, 1.2 km

distance_verbose: 60 km, 35 km, 26 km, 18 km, 15 km, 12 km, 7 km, 2 km, 1 km

name: Noordduinloop
description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The races offer a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The Noordduinloop, part of this series, takes place on 13 March 2027 and is one of a series of events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
A unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all levels and ages
additional: Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men. The rankings are based on the four best results in the series. Distances range from 500m to 10 km, including kids' runs, with rankings based on the four best results.

name: Kranenbroeker Bosloop
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8.5 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. It consists of four races held during the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. Electronic timing is provided, and race numbers can be collected in advance or on race day.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 at IKC De Wooldermarke, Semmelweisstraat 46, 7555 NT Hengelo. The race number includes a timing chip and must be worn on the chest. A running shirt and medal are available as optional extras when registering in advance. Shower and changing facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg and close at 13:15. Race numbers can be collected on the preceding Saturday or on race day. Participants use the same race number for all four races. The standings are based on at least 3 of the 4 races. Bringing animals or pushchairs and using earbuds/headphones is discouraged or not permitted. Registration opens at 9:00, and the courses run through the countryside around Hengelo. Results from previous years are available, and the event has been organised for more than 45 years.

name: Alfa Laval Stevensloop
description: The Alfa Laval Stevensloop is Nijmegen’s city run, taking place on 20 March 2027. The start is in the iconic Kronenburgerpark, and the finish is right in the centre of the oldest city in the Netherlands. The different courses offer varied routes through the city centre, past the city island, along Nijmegen’s skyline and through the natural surroundings of the Ooijpolder. The event is organised by Stichting Zevenheuvelenloop, which aims to get as many people as possible moving and provide a great running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Kronenburgerpark and finish at the Grote Markt
Climb up the Voerweg, featuring the Alfa Laval Cheering Zone
Varied routes through the city and nature, passing iconic sights such as the Stevenskerk and the Ooijpolder
additional: A supervised cloakroom for small bags is available at the start in Kronenburgerpark. The Voerweg is a challenging climb towards the end of the 5 km and half marathon, with a special Alfa Laval Cheering Zone where spectators and music provide extra encouragement. The Alfa Laval Hill Challenge rewards the fastest climb up the Voerweg with a €100 gift voucher for Runnersworld. Registration opens on 1 October 2026, race numbers can be collected in March 2027, and the event takes place on 20 and 21 March 2027.

name: Molenloop Vrouwenparochie

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De online verkoop van startkaarten kan tot en met vrijdag 26 december 2025.

description: The Midseumer Molnkoier is a unique evening walk that invites walkers to enjoy nature and culture in and around Vrouwenparochie. This walking event is made possible in part by many volunteers and sponsors, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The route passes the old grain mill and winds through the beautiful Frisian countryside, offering a special experience for lovers of walking and cultural history.
course_highlights: Evening walk past the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen
Natural and cultural surroundings of Vrouwenparochie
Unique atmosphere during midwinter and a scenic route
additional: Entry tickets can also be purchased at the start desk. The walking event is held at the old grain mill, De Vrouwbuurtstermolen, in Vrouwenparochie. Registration is available for several distances, and participants can enjoy a course through the beautiful countryside and mill surroundings.

name: Monnikenloop
description: The Monnikenloop is an annual running race held on the beautiful island of Schiermonnikoog. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run, 5 km, 10 km and 10 English Miles, and attracts both recreational and dedicated runners. The event combines sporting spirit with a friendly atmosphere and invites participants to experience the island’s unique nature. The start and finish are centrally located, and there is plenty of opportunity to enjoy an atmospheric weekend with accommodation available on the island.
course_highlights: Routes across the island of Schiermonnikoog, through nature and dunes
Distances ranging from a 1 km kids’ run to 10 English Miles (16.1 km)
Start and finish in the village, in an atmospheric setting
additional: Kids’ runs start from 11:20, the 5 km starts at 12:40, the 10 km at 12:50 and the 10 English Miles at 12:30. The race pack includes a race number with chip and a bus pass for transport on the island. Participants must reserve their own ferry ticket. A running shirt can be ordered. Changes to registration can be made for a fee until the end of March. The start and finish are in the village, with changing and shower facilities. Several distances; registration opens on 1 October 2026; accommodation is available on the island; the event takes place in March.

name: Oldemeijercross
location: Recreatieplas De Oldemeijer, Hardenberg, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Oldemeijercross is one of the oldest running races in the region and is organized annually by AV Spurt'88. The race takes place around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake in Hardenberg and offers a challenging course with tough climbs, sand, and mud. This running event is for all ages, with the start and finish on the event hill at Oldemeijer. Spectators can cheer on the runners from several spots, adding to the lively, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Tough climbs along the course
Route around the De Oldemeijer recreational lake
Sandy and muddy terrain
additional: Race-day registration is possible. The start and finish are on the event hill at Oldemeijer. The course is suitable for all ages, and there are several places for spectators to cheer on the runners. The 3 km course around Oldemeijer is challenging, with climbs, sand, and mud; the start and finish are at the event hill; registration via inschrijven.nl; no showers available.

name: Reeuwijkse Plassenloop
description: The Vosplan Reeuwijkse Plassenloop is one of the oldest running events in the Netherlands and has been held for more than 70 years. Each year, the event attracts runners from the region and beyond, who enjoy an active and sociable day. The course is completely flat and has little traffic. It runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the distinctive Reeuwijkse Plassen, making it an appealing and fast course. There are distances for all ages, from kids’ runs to 15 kilometres, including supervised youth distances.
course_highlights: Completely flat course with little traffic
Runs through Reeuwijkse Hout and along the Reeuwijkse Plassen
Clear kilometre markers and one lap per distance (5, 10 and 15 km)
additional: MYLAPS BibTag timing is used. The chip is attached to the back of the race number and does not need to be returned. Late registration is available on race day from 10:30 until half an hour before the start. The start and finish area is at Reeuwijkse Houtwal in the De Reeuwijkse Hout recreation area. Ample parking and toilets are available. There are no changing or shower facilities. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Cash prizes are awarded for the 5, 10 and 15 km races for men and women, plus an additional prize for a course record. Registration opens on 1 January 2027 via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers prizes and keepsakes for the winners, and preparation training sessions are available. Participants can register for different distances and age groups.

name: Marathon Alblasserwaard 750
description: The Alblasserwaard 750 Marathon is a unique, one-time marathon taking place on 20 March 2027 to celebrate 750 years of Alblasserwaard history. The 42.195-kilometre route runs from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk, through characteristic polders, windmills, historic waterways and villages, to the finish at AV Typhoon in Gorinchem. The marathon offers runners a special experience through the open peat-meadow landscape and past iconic windmills and duck decoys, with the region’s landscape and history at its heart.
course_highlights: Start at Kinderdijk’s 19 windmills, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Route along separated cycle paths and roads with limited traffic
Past historic waterways, polder windmills and characteristic villages
additional: Shuttle buses will run between Gorinchem and Kinderdijk for participants. Parking at the start is not possible and is discouraged. Bicycle parking is available at both the start and finish. The organisers aim to be sustainable by using biodegradable cups and cleaning the course after the event. Sweeper vehicles are available for runners who drop out. The minimum age to participate is 18. The marathon is a unique, one-time event celebrating the region’s history and beauty, with a maximum limit of 2,500 runners.

name: Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer
location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog, Municipality Noardeast-Fryslân, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Dark Sky Trail Lauwersmeer is a unique nighttime running and walking event held in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer, one of the darkest areas in Europe. The race offers three events: canicross, trail running and a walking tour, all approximately 10 km long. Participants run in the dark, with headlamps permitted only in emergencies, creating a special experience. Registration raises awareness of light pollution through a donation for each participant.
course_highlights: Nighttime route in the official Dark Sky Park Lauwersmeer
Approximately 10 km for canicross, trail running and the walking tour
Headlamps permitted only in emergencies
additional: The start location and meeting point is Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, De Rug 1, 9976VT Lauwersoog. A drink is available at the finish. Estimated duration is approximately 1 hour 45 minutes for trail runners and canicross participants, and approximately 2 hours 45 minutes for walkers. night run, canicross, walking tour, 10 km, start location: Activiteitencentrum Lauwersnest, Lauwersoog
