tiers.description: Teams: inschrijven tot en met 17 mei; 30 euro per team, alleen voorinschrijven mogelijk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten: 4,00 euro. Betalen via internet (bijv Ideal)

description: The ZLM-Don Stadsloop is a friendly running race through Middelburg city centre, starting and finishing at the Markt. The race consists of 3 laps of 2.5 km, for a total of 7.5 km, and features both an individual ranking and a team ranking for teams of 4. There are separate age categories and prizes for the top runners. Before the race, children can take part in the Qui-Vive Spektakelrun, a fun participation run of approximately 2 km with obstacles. The organisers provide a lively, sporting evening with refreshments, first aid and a raffle afterwards.
course_highlights: Middelburg city centre, starting and finishing at the Markt
3 laps of 2.5 km, for a total of 7.5 km
Qui-Vive Spektakelrun for children, featuring 5 inflatable obstacle courses
additional: Race numbers can be collected on 19, 20 and 21 May at Koole Sport, and on race day, 22 May, between 18:30 and 19:30 at the stall on the Markt. Late registration is available only for the individual race, digitally from 18 May and on race day. Race numbers are entered into a raffle with prizes and a grand prize. After finishing, participants receive a bottle of water and a memento. First-aid staff are present, including on bicycles. Teams consist of 4 people; mixed teams are included in the men's team ranking. A €100 course-record bonus is awarded for setting a new record. Prizes for the top 3 and participants, a raffle using race numbers, first aid on site, and changing rooms in the Molenwater gymnasium.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

name: Lelieloop
location: Het Turfschip, Etten-Leur, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Lelieloop is organised annually by Road Runners Etten-Leur on Whit Monday as part of De Leurse Havenfeesten. The fast course runs through the streets of Etten-Leur Noord and passes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill, among other places. There are several distances for different age groups, including a children’s run, a junior run, a 5 km and a 10 km. The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, which also has shower and changing facilities. The Lelieloop is an accessible event for all ages, with a friendly atmosphere and a scenic route through the neighbourhood and past local landmarks.
course_highlights: The course goes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill
Routes run through the Schoenmakershoek neighbourhood and along the Leurse Dijk
The 10 km and 5 km courses are accurately measured and include a mix of paved and unpaved sections
additional: The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, with changing and shower facilities. Kangoo jumpers and race runners are welcome, but the course is not suitable for wheelchair racers. If temperatures exceed 30 degrees, the Lelieloop is cancelled in accordance with Atletiekunie rules. Every child receives a pancake from the De Lelie windmill after the children’s run. The course is not officially measured and may vary; advance registration is recommended; the run is cancelled if temperatures exceed 30°C.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijving is geopend vanaf 1 februari 2027 tot en met 13 mei 2027. Restitutie is niet mogelijk.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost € 225,- per team van 4 personen inclusief de 5de loper. Bij meer dan twee teams korting mogelijk.

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

name: Liberation Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnamekosten zijn voor iedereen gelijk, ongeacht volledige of halve etappes

description: The Liberation Trail is a three-day trail-running adventure along Normandy’s historic D-Day beaches. This unique experience combines an athletic challenge with a tribute to freedom and history. Participants cover a total of 113 kilometres across key liberation sites, including Utah Beach, Omaha Beach and other landing sites. The event focuses on perseverance and respect, with an emphasis on the significance of the route rather than competition.
course_highlights: Route along the iconic D-Day beaches and historic monuments
Night-time sections by the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc
Start in Sainte-Mère-Église, known for the famous paratrooper John Steele
additional: The trail is flexible: participants can choose the full 115 km route or a selection of half stages totalling 70 km. Base camp is Camping Ferme Hay Day, where participants can relax and share experiences. There is no time pressure; the focus is on personal challenge and respect for history. The event includes several days of trail running, with options for full or half routes, historical tours and camping facilities. Bus transfers from the Netherlands and Belgium are also available. The race takes place from 21 to 23 May 2027.

name: Gerard Tebroke Memorialloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven voor de GUV Businessrun : €125 per deelnemend team.

description: The Gerard Tebroke Memorial Run is an annual running event in Aalten offering various distances and categories, including kids’ runs, schoolchildren’s runs, business runs, and 5- and 10-kilometer races. The event takes place on Saturday, May 22, 2027, and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Start times are spread throughout the afternoon and evening, allowing participants and spectators to enjoy a varied program.
course_highlights: Multiple race categories for all ages and ability levels
Location in the center of Aalten
Memorial run in honor of Gerard Tebroke
additional: Late registration for the 5- and 10-kilometer races is available at the registration desk at Markt 7, Aalten. Start times: 16:30 Het Noorden Kids’ Runs, 17:00 GUV Schoolchildren’s Run, 18:00 Sorba 5-Kilometer Run and GUV Business Run 5KM, 18:45 Ducona 10-Kilometer Run. The event is held every two years and has strong local and sporting significance.

name: Freedom Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 15 en is hetzelfde voor alle afstanden.

description: The Freedom Run Wageningen is a running event that celebrates freedom and connection in the city of liberation. Organised by Lions Club Wageningen, participants run in support of Stichting Kind en Kans, which supports children from families with limited means. The run offers four distances and takes participants through beautiful natural areas and the city, mainly along paved cycle paths. Everyone is welcome to take part and contribute to a future in which no child is left on the sidelines.
course_highlights: Routes start at Visum Mundi in the Vrijheidskwartier
The 15 km and half marathon routes pass through natural areas and include approximately 90 metres of elevation gain
Finish with a scenic descent towards the finish at Visum Mundi
additional: Timing with a Race Result bib tag at the start/finish; an additional live intermediate timing point at 6 km for the 15k and 21k. A medal is available for €5. T-shirts can be ordered when registering. The organisers encourage sustainable transport and use sustainable materials, such as medals made from potato starch or waste wood and rPET cups at drink stations. Setting: city run; timing via bib tag; start/finish at Visum Mundi; parking near the start/finish; registration by advance entry only.

name: Liemerse Landloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname voor de Kidsrun vanaf 4 jaar tot en met 12 jaar is kosteloos, nog wel even inschrijven.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bij de voorschrijving voor de 3 km is € 10,00.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bij de voorschrijving voor de 5 km is € 12,–.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bij de voorschrijving voor de 10 km is € 12,–.

description: The Liemerse Landloop is an annual running event held on the fourth Sunday in May in Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy. The course passes through picturesque villages and along the Liemerse dikes, with official certification for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a free Kids’ Run for children up to 12 years old. The atmosphere is warm and festive, with strong volunteer involvement and a lovely keepsake for every participant.
course_highlights: Officially measured and certified 5 km and 10 km courses
Route through the countryside around Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy, along the Liemerse dikes
Start and finish at Koffiehuis Uniek, Kerkweg 10 in Oud-Zevenaar
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 30 May from 15:00 to 16:30 and on race day from 08:45 at Koffiehuis Uniek. Parking is available at Dijkweg and at the station, with shuttle buses running from 10:00. Prize-giving ceremonies take place after each distance on the terrace at the start/finish location. The Kids’ Run is divided into age groups, with distances of 500 and 1,000 metres. Teams of 3 to 5 people can take part in the 5 km. Registration is available online and on site; the event is run with the help of volunteers and offers various running categories.

name: Maastricht Marathon
description: The dsm-firmenich Maastricht Marathon is a unique running event that is part of the dsm-firmenich Long Course Weekend Netherlands. The race offers a flat, picturesque course through the historic and scenic landscape of Maastricht and the surrounding area. With distances of 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a full marathon, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from recreational runners to serious athletes. Crossing the finish line over the red carpet makes for a festive and unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Flat, picturesque course through historic Maastricht
Start and finish in the bustling heart of the city, with cheering crowds
Past iconic landmarks and local street parties
additional: Pacers are available for the marathon and half marathon, with several target times from 1:30 to 5:00 hours. The pacers are identifiable by their T-shirts and flags and help runners achieve their desired finish time. The event is part of a three-day multisport festival featuring swimming, cycling and running. Part of a three-day multisport event including swimming and cycling; suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Amsterdam UMC Run
description: The Amsterdam UMC Run is a unique running event that takes participants through Amsterdam UMC hospital and the green surroundings of Amsterdam Zuidoost. Participants can choose from the 1.2 km Family Run, 5 km, 10 km, or the challenging hat trick, in which all distances are run separately. Alongside the sporting aspect, the event aims to raise money for research and improvements to patient care at Amsterdam UMC. It offers a fun day with music, food trucks, entertainment, and a kids’ corner, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Routes go right through Amsterdam UMC hospital
Start corrals for the 5 km and 10 km provide plenty of space on the course
Aid stations with water and fruit along the route
additional: Start corrals for the 5 km (Green and Blue) and 10 km, with groups of around 300 participants starting every 10 minutes. Race numbers will be ready for collection at the event site and will not be mailed. Employees and visitors can collect their race numbers earlier at the AMC site. A unique running shirt can be ordered, with part of the proceeds going to research. Aid stations with water and fruit along the route. First aid will be available. The course is closed to traffic. Registration is online; the event supports various medical research projects, including cancer and dementia research. The event is car-free and suitable for all ages.

name: Halve Marathon Veghel
location: Prins Willem Alexander Sportpark, Veghel, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Half Marathon Veghel is an annual running event held on the last weekend of May in Veghel. The course is a 7.09-kilometre loop that participants run three times, with the start and finish at Fit Functional. The event is intended both for recreational runners looking to run their first half marathon and for experienced runners aiming for a fast time. Safety and runner support are central, with first-aid facilities and aid stations along the route. The organiser, Fit Functional, is committed to offering a professional, well-organised event and encouraging sport and health in the region.
course_highlights: A 7.09 km course run three times, for a total of 21.1 km
Start and finish at Fit Functional, with an aid station and split-time recording
Route along footpaths and cycle paths in the countryside around Veghel
additional: First-aid facilities are available at the start and finish. Participants must obey traffic rules and follow the organiser’s instructions. Drink stations are located at Fit Functional. The event is planned for Prins Willem Alexander Sports Park; registration opens on 1 February 2026; a permit application for 2027 has been submitted.

name: Meppel City Run
distance_verbose: 12.9 km, 6.4 km, 3000 meter, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.2 km
description: The Meppel City Run is a running event through Meppel’s historic city centre, with a choice of 4 or 8 English miles. The fully paved, traffic-free route passes beautiful places such as Wilhelminapark and several lively streets. Alongside the main distances, there are also a Kidsrun, G-Run and Frame-Run, making the event suitable for recreational runners, experienced athletes and athletes with disabilities. The start and finish are in the city centre, making for an atmospheric and sporty day for everyone.
course_highlights: Fully paved, traffic-free route over cobblestones
Start on Grote Oever and finish on Kromme Elleboog
Run through the historic city centre and past Wilhelminapark
additional: The 8-mile race consists of two laps of the 4-mile course, which is extra fun for spectators. All events start on Grote Oever, and the Kidsrun, Frame-Run and G-Run also finish there. There is a warm-up for the G-Run and Kidsrun. All children receive a medal after the event. There is a Business Run for teams of 3 to 5 participants. The course is certified by the Atletiek Unie. The event also includes activities such as warm-up sessions and an awards ceremony, and offers registration by email. The organisers cater to a broad audience, from young runners to experienced athletes.

name: Quintusloop
description: The Quintusloop is a running event in Hengelo where participants can choose between distances of 10 and 21 kilometres. The aim is to raise money for research into multiple sclerosis (MS), driven by a personal wish to offer hope to people living with the disease. The event is organised in support of the MS Research Foundation and highlights the importance of running together for a future with better treatments and more research.
course_highlights: Distances of 10 and 21 kilometres
Running for the cause of MS research
Held in Hengelo
additional: The Quintusloop is a fundraising event where participants run together to raise money for MS research, with a personal motivation to support a friend who has been diagnosed with MS. A newsletter is available to keep people up to date with activities. The website highlights the importance of research and hope for people with MS. The race supports MS research and awareness, with a route that includes both paved and unpaved roads.

name: Rotte Dam Loop
description: The Rotte Dam Loop is a social running and walking event in Rotterdam, where participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings along the Rotte river. There are four distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos, and 10 km and 21 km along the Rotte from the dam to Outdoor Valley. The event is not timed, so everyone can enjoy the activity and atmosphere at their own pace. The race is known for its friendly, accessible character for runners and walkers of all levels.
course_highlights: 1 km kids’ run and 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos
10 km and 21 km along the Rotte river
Start at the dam and finish at Outdoor Valley
additional: The race is not timed, and both running and walking are possible. There is a Rotte Dam Loop Festival at the finish. The 2026 event was sold out, and a waiting list was available. The event emphasizes enjoyment and togetherness, with a focus on accessibility for everyone. The anniversary edition in 2026 was a great success, and the organizers continue to focus on a friendly, social experience for all participants.

name: The Royal Ten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUNT Hypotheken Business Run €270 per team (ex. btw)

description: The Royal Ten is The Hague’s most sociable running event, organised annually by The Hague Road Runners. The event offers various distances and races, including an officially measured 10-kilometre race that runs through Haagse Bos and past Huis ten Bosch Palace. The course is completely traffic-free and fast, with clear kilometre markers and a water station at 5 km. The organisers are committed to providing a safe and enjoyable running experience for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course officially measured and certified by the Atletiekunie
Course runs through Beatrixkwartier and Haagse Bos, and past Huis ten Bosch Palace
Completely traffic-free course with clear kilometre markers and a water station
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day or on Saturday 30 May. Bag drop is available at the NH Hotel, but there are no changing rooms. A free first-aid station is available in the start/finish area. There is a water station at 5 km, with additional stations in warm weather. Minimum age: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km. The organisers accept no liability, and refunds are not available if you are unable to participate. The event takes place on 30 May 2027 and offers various categories for runners of all levels.

name: Sasloop
description: The Sasloop is a traditional time trial organized by AV'56 for its own members. The race takes place on Tuesday evening and starts at 19:15 at Sportpark ’t Schenge in Goes. The course is approximately 7.8 kilometers long and runs out and back to the Goese Sas. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, with the fastest runner starting last. Times are recorded electronically using chip bibs, and the results are published on the AV'56 website after the race.
course_highlights: Approximately 7.8 km out-and-back course to the Goese Sas
Start and finish on the cycle path in front of the entrance to Sportpark ’t Schenge
Individual starts at 30-second intervals
additional: Participation is free and exclusive to AV'56 members. Chip bibs are distributed in the canteen between 18:30 and 19:00. The bib must not be attached with magnets or folded, and must be worn clearly on the front. The course is not closed to traffic; take care when crossing and watch out for oncoming cyclists. Results are announced in the canteen after the race and published online later. The race takes place on a course that is not closed to traffic, and registration is in advance via the website. The race offers members a great opportunity to test their speed and take part in an organized time trial.

name: Hollen in Heesch
description: Hollen in Heesch is a running event for all ages and abilities, from beginners to advanced runners, held in the heart of Heesch. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy a beautiful course through the village, with the start and finish in the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic. The event concludes with a lively afterparty at the same location, making it a sporting and festive highlight for everyone. The run is open to individuals, groups, friends, and colleagues, and offers a warm and enthusiastic atmosphere.
course_highlights: A beautiful 2.5 km course through the heart of Heesch
Depending on the distance, run 2 or 4 laps through the streets of Heesch
Start and finish in the atmospheric courtyard of the Eijnderic
additional: There is a 1- or 2-kilometer Kids Run for children. A 10-week start-to-run training course is offered in collaboration with Fruntrunners to prepare beginner runners. The event ends with an afterparty in the courtyard of the Eijnderic. Volunteers are welcome to help with various tasks, such as monitoring barriers and handing out water. The event is aimed at all ages, with an emphasis on community spirit, fun, and an afterparty.

name: KLM Aruba Marathon
location: Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort, Oranjestad, Aruba
description: The KLM Aruba Marathon is an officially certified marathon by World Athletics and AIMS, held on the beautiful island of Aruba. The race offers a tropical running experience along Aruba’s coastline, with the start and finish at the Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort. It features several distances, including the full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, and is known for its festive atmosphere and post-race beach party. The race is a unique combination of sport, culture and vacation, ideal for competitive runners and recreational participants alike.
course_highlights: A tropical route along Aruba’s coast, including Eagle Beach and the famous lighthouse
The full marathon consists of two loops of the half marathon; it starts in the dark and finishes in daylight
14 water stations on the marathon route, with Powerade and bananas at selected points
additional: Race packet pickup is at the Grand Ballroom of Hilton Aruba Caribbean Resort on June 4th (08:00-17:00) and June 5th (08:00-12:30). The race features a Track & Trace app for live tracking. The full marathon has a 6-hour time limit, with a sweeper vehicle enforcing cutoffs. Post-race celebrations include awards ceremonies and beach parties on both race days. Participants receive a personalized start number, timing chip, finisher medal, and a complimentary UV-protective dry-fit running shirt. The course includes beaches and city roads; registration requires ID and age verification; race-day activities include awards ceremonies and festive beach parties.

name: De brabantse wal marathon
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Eiberrun
description: The Eiberrun is a friendly and sporty running event in Eibergen, taking place on Sunday 6 June 2027. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a corporate run, kids’ runs and a spectacular Urban Fun Run for young people. The event starts and finishes at the welcoming De Brink sports square, which is transformed into a lively venue especially for the occasion. The routes pass through the village and the Mallum countryside, with challenging and enjoyable courses for all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The 10 km distance covers the 5 km loop through the village and Mallum countryside twice
Start and finish at the welcoming De Brink sports square
Urban Fun Run route through shops and over obstacles in the village
additional: Race numbers with timing chips will be ready for collection at the registration desk on De Brink. They can be collected on Saturday 5 June (time to be confirmed) and on Sunday 6 June from 09:00 until half an hour before the start. For registrations received before 12:00 on 31 May, the participant’s name will appear on the race number. Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 at a higher price. Prize ceremonies will take place at around 12:00 and 13:00. ASV Eibergen also offers clinics and training sessions to help participants prepare. Registration for the event on 6 June 2027 is open, with clinics and volunteer opportunities also available. The event starts and finishes at De Brink sports square, where participants can also enjoy the friendly atmosphere.

name: Gaperloop
description: The Gaperloop is a fast, flat running event held annually in Gapinge. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, and attracts both recreational and competitive runners. With an evening start time of 19:30, it is an ideal race for anyone who enjoys a fast, sociable event. The Gaperloop is organized by Loopgroep Gonzalez and has a long tradition, with eight editions to date.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Evening start at 19:30
additional: Registration for the Gaperloop opens in March 2026. There are categories for men and women, both open and 40+. The race is now fully booked for 2026. The organizer is Loopgroep Gonzalez. The race takes place on 11 June 2027 at 19:30, with categories for different ages and prizes for top finishers. Participation is at your own risk, and all finishers receive a pair of running Gaper socks.

name: Loop door Houten
description: Loop door Houten is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Houten. It offers a range of distances, from the Kidsrun and Jeugdloop for primary school children to the 5 and 10 kilometres, the SAMSAMLOOP for pairs, and a team race for teams of four runners. The course passes through Oude Dorp and Castellum, with the finish at Het Plein, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants. Volunteers play an important role in the event’s success, which is also a celebration of running and having fun together.
course_highlights: Kidsrun and Jeugdloop through Oude Dorp, with several passes over Het Plein
5 and 10 km course with water stations in Castellum and a pass over Het Plein
Team race in which four runners finish together after relay handovers at various points
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 16:00 to 19:15 in the hall of Roskam in Oude Dorp. Digital late registration is available until 18:00 on the day of the event, as long as the maximum number of participants has not been reached. Pre-registration opens on 15 March. The schedule includes a warm-up for the Kidsrun/Jeugdloop and a walking event at 17:45, with the walks starting at 18:00, the Kidsrun at 18:10, the Jeugdloop at 18:25, the SAMSAMLOOP at 19:10, and the 5 km, 10 km and Team Race at 19:40. Awards are presented in various categories after the event. Training opportunities and course familiarisation sessions are offered beforehand. The organisers ask participants to prepare properly, including by following advice on running in high temperatures. Distances range from the Kidsrun (1 km) to 10 km, including the Jeugdloop and SAMSAMLOOP. Registration is open and volunteers are wanted. The event takes place in Houten.

name: Omloop van Empel
description: The Omloop van Empel is a popular running race held annually in Empel. The anniversary edition attracts around 1,000 participants each year and is known for its sporty, friendly atmosphere. The organizers work hard to make it a wonderful day filled with socializing and sport. Participants and spectators are invited to enjoy this special running experience together.
course_highlights: Various distances for all levels
Friendly atmosphere with music and drinks
Includes children’s races and family activities
additional: Registration for the 10th edition is closed, and all race entries have been allocated. Around 1,000 participants are expected. The organizers encourage people to come cheer on the participants and experience the event’s atmosphere. Running and walking event; registration via inschrijven.nl; start location: Asmunt 3, Empel

name: Grachtenloop
description: The Zorgspecialist Grachtenloop is an atmospheric evening run through Haarlem’s beautiful old town, with participants running along the canals and waterways. The course passes various cultural and tourist attractions and is supported by enthusiastic spectators, bands and DJs. The 10 km distance consists of two laps of the 5 km course. There is also a Hero KidsRun for children aged 4 and up, and a BusinessRun with extra facilities. The event offers a unique combination of sport and conviviality in a historic city setting.
course_highlights: Course through Haarlem’s old town, along canals and waterways
Passes various cultural and tourist attractions
Musical support from bands and DJs along the course
additional: Registration includes a first name on the race bib, official results on the website, a safe, closed course, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, medical care, a personal finish video, a unique medal, entertainment, timekeeping by ChronoRace, and home delivery of the race bib via PostNL for registrations before 1 June. The BusinessRun includes a VIP location, food, drinks and massage. Group registration is also available, with separate invoicing and race bib delivery. The event provides race bibs, a course, refreshment stations, a medal, entertainment, timekeeping and medical support. Race bibs are delivered to the homes of participants in the Netherlands.

name: Heuvelrugloop
description: The Heuvelrugloop is a popular forest run in Maarn, known as the most beautiful forest run in the Netherlands. The race is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, in which participants can also take part in the Uilentoren Loop Leersum and the Koploop in Amerongen for a combined ranking and a discount. The event offers challenging courses through the wooded area of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and attracts around 1,000 runners each year. A running clinic is also available to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: Wooded setting in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Distances of 4.2 km, 10 km and half marathon
Participants experience a challenging and varied course
additional: The Heuvelrugloop is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, offering additional recognition and a discount for taking part in multiple events. A running clinic is available through RunXperience to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km. The event attracts around 1,000 participants each year and offers a challenging course through a wooded area. Terrain: forest; registration: not specified; part of a challenge featuring multiple runs; preparation through RunXperience.nl

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: 7 euro voorinschrijving, 8 euro tijdens de wedstrijd
description: The Ronde van Nieuwveen is a running race held in and around the village of Nieuwveen, and is part of the Gemeente Nieuwkoop Circuit. The race takes place on the longest evening of the year and offers various distances for both children and adults. Children up to age 13 can take part in free kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km, while adults can choose from 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes. The race features a varied course through the neighbourhood and village, with special attention paid to ensuring runners are well spread out along the course.
course_highlights: Course in and around Nieuwveen, starting and finishing at W.P. Speelmanweg
Kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km through the neighbourhood and village
5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes running through and around Nieuwveen
additional: Start and finish at W.P. Speelmanweg, with changing facilities, showers and supervised bag drop. There is a special G-run for participants with intellectual or physical disabilities, who can run with accompanying guides. Parking is available at the town hall, Teylersplein 1, and at De Hogendijk next to the football pitches. Children can participate for free, but advance registration is requested to keep things running smoothly. Course through and around Nieuwveen, various distances for children and adults, free participation for children and the G-run, changing facilities and supervised bag drop.

name: Havendagen Run
description: The Havendagenrun Terneuzen is a sporting race held in Terneuzen city centre. The second edition offers a unique route through the city, with distances of 1, 3 and 5 nautical miles (1.85 km, 5.55 km and 9.25 km). The start and finish are at Veerplein, close to the pontoon. The 1 km Kidsrun for children up to 12 starts a little earlier. The race is suitable for all ages and offers a sporting challenge, with an improved course compared to last year.
course_highlights: A unique route through Terneuzen city centre
Start and finish at Veerplein, close to the pontoon
Run past Stadhuisplein and the Markt
additional: There is a 1 km Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old, starting at 18:15. The Havendagenrun takes place on Friday, 26 June 2026. The route has been improved compared to last year for a better running experience. Registration via inschrijven.nl. The event is part of the Havendagen, which features various festivities in Terneuzen.

name: Lingewaalloop
price_range: Jeugdlopen en jongeren t/m 15 jaar gratis; 5 km €10 voorinschrijving, €13 op de dag; 10 km €12 voorinschrijving, €15 op de dag
description: The Lingewaalloop is a friendly running race organised by Stichting Lingewaalloop Herwijnen, aimed at residents of Herwijnen and the surrounding area. The race offers several distances, including children’s races and 5 km and 10 km events. The course starts and finishes on Vervoornlaan and follows the Waaldijk. The children’s race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, while the 5 km and 10 km runners complete a loop along the dike and Achterweg. Facilities include changing rooms and showers, and there is an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: Children’s race on and around Vervoornlaan
5 km loop via Achterweg, Waaldijk and Katerdam
The 10 km consists of two laps of the same 5 km loop
additional: On-the-day registration and collection of children’s race bibs are available from 09:30 at the De Kol football clubhouse. Changing rooms and showers are available at De Kol sports park. The children’s awards ceremony takes place at the finish; the 5 km and 10 km awards ceremonies are held afterwards in the football clubhouse. Parking is along Parallelweg; do not park at nearby shops. There are ten age categories for men and women, regardless of race licence. The race takes place on and around Vervoornlaan, with registration available in advance and on the day, and facilities at De Kol sports park. The 2027 edition has been cancelled due to extreme temperatures.

name: Kadeloop
description: The Moore DRV-Kadeloop in Schipluiden is a traditional running event held annually on the first Saturday of July since 1978. The main distance is 12 km through the green Midden-Delfland area and along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden. There is also a 5 km run and a 1 km and 2 km junior race. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and friendly atmosphere and is part of the Zomer Runcircuit.
course_highlights: 12 km route through the green Midden-Delfland area
Run along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden
Junior races of 1 km and 2 km, specially for children
additional: Race bib collection for children: 10:00–11:00; for other distances: 11:00–13:00 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. Parking is available at VV Schipluiden. Chip-based electronic timing for the 5 km and 12 km. Water stations along the route and at the finish. Prize-giving immediately after the children's race, for the 5 km at around 15:00, and for the 12 km at around 15:30 at the VV Schipluiden clubhouse. No on-site registration; registration is online only until 2 July 2027 at 23:59. Race bibs may be transferred until 2 July at 21:00 via the registration website. Distances: 12 km, 5 km, junior race (1 km and 2 km); activities include Nordic walking and walking; location: Schipluiden, Midden-Delfland.

name: 76e Stratenloop Tuitjenhorn
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Stratenloop Zoutelande
description: The Stratenloop Zoutelande is an atmospheric running race held in the picturesque village of Zoutelande. Organized by Dynamica Sport, the race attracts both competitive runners and recreational runners and offers a challenging course through the village streets. The race has a long tradition and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. Participants can register via an online platform and enjoy a well-organized day.
course_highlights: Course through the atmospheric streets of Zoutelande
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
Organized by the local athletics club Dynamica Sport
additional: Dynamica members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering in advance. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl. The race is open to both official competition athletes and recreational runners. Registration for the race on 7 July 2027 is open via an online form. The race distance is not explicitly stated, but the 2025 edition was 9.9 km. The event attracts runners from the region and beyond.

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

name: Turfveld Zomercross, Texel

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inschrijfgeld voor de jeugd tot en met 12 jaar € 2,-

description: The Turfveld Summer Cross in Den Burg, Texel, is an atmospheric running race held on Sunday mornings in July and August. The route passes through Texel’s varied landscape, with a sheltered course in the forest, a challenging climb and beautiful trails. There are several distances for different age groups, including a separate loop for children. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with registration from 9:45 a.m. at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld.
course_highlights: Varied forest landscape with sheltered trails
Challenging climb along the course
Beautiful natural trails
additional: Registration is available from 9:45 a.m. at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2, 1791 PB Den Burg. Separate distances are offered for children up to 12 years old (1 km), ages 13 to 15 (2 km), and ages 15 and over (4 and 8 km). The race is held every Sunday in July and August. Running race with several distances, located in a wooded area, registration from 9:45 a.m., start at 10:30 a.m.

description: The Moore DRV Run Maasdijk is a friendly running race in the Westland, held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk. The main distance is 10 kilometres on a traffic-free, fast asphalt course through the polder and along iconic dikes. There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.
course_highlights: Traffic-free course through the polder and along dikes
Entirely paved, fast asphalt course with water stations
Iconic finish location in the village of Maasdijk
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:30 at the canteen of korfbalvereniging Dijkvogels, Lange Kruisweg 44F in Maasdijk. The 5 km starts at 14:00, followed by the 10 km at 14:10. Changing and shower facilities are available at the korfbalvereniging. Results are recorded using a SAW chip, which costs €4.50 as a one-time fee and is not included in the entry fee. The youth run takes place without a chip. The race is held during the Zomerspektakel in Maasdijk and offers a friendly atmosphere for all ages, including youth activities and special keepsakes for participants.

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

description: The Kustloop Vrouwenpolder is a challenging half marathon known as “Walchers mooiste” (Walcheren’s most beautiful). The approximately 21.1-kilometre route runs along Lake Veere and over the North Sea beach, with beautiful views and nature areas around Vrouwenpolder. Runners can also take part in shorter distances of 12 km and 6 km. The start is on Dorpsdijk, near the Pelgrimskerk, and refreshment stations are available approximately every 5 kilometres. Registration includes a T-shirt for walkers or a singlet for runners.
course_highlights: Approximately 9 km along Lake Veere
Route over the North Sea beach
Beautiful nature areas around Vrouwenpolder
additional: Walkers start at 10:30, and runners at 11:30. The prize-giving takes place as soon as a podium has been completed. Changing facilities are available in the gym a short walk from the start. Race numbers can be transferred or resold via the personal dashboard until 26 August 2026. A refreshment station is available approximately every 5 kilometres. The course runs along Lake Veere and the North Sea beach; registration includes a T-shirt or singlet, and changing facilities are available.

description: The Rondje Oude IJsselstreek is an annual relay race organized by athletics club Atletico’73, in which teams of seven runners cover distances between 4 and 7 kilometers. The start and finish are at the Atletico'73 athletics track in Gendringen. The route passes through a beautiful green setting and several villages in the municipality of Oude IJsselstreek. Participants enjoy the event as a fun, sporty activity to share with their teammates.
course_highlights: 7 stages of between 4 and 7 kilometers through a green setting
Routes through the villages of Ulft, Silvolde, Westendorp, Sinderen and Voorst
A mix of paved and unpaved roads and paths, sometimes with loose sand
additional: Teams consist of 7 people, with at least 1 woman and 1 man. There are two start waves, with the slower wave starting first. Bonus and penalty minutes are awarded based on the team’s gender mix and speed. Prizes are awarded to the fastest team, the last team, and teams that finish in specific places. Cycling routes are available to reach the relay points without crossing the running routes. Untrained runners and participants under 14 are advised not to take part. 7 distances between 4 and 7 km, course on paved and unpaved roads, start and finish at the Atletico’73 Gendringen athletics track

name: Iedema Building Run 2026
description: The Iedema Building Run 2026 in Harderwijk is a sporting event focused on exercise, social connection and entrepreneurship, with a special emphasis on supporting the Prinses Beatrix Spierfonds. Participants can walk or run and help raise money for research into muscle diseases. The event encourages individual and team fundraising efforts to make a positive impact on the lives of people with muscle diseases. It is an inclusive and meaningful run for anyone who wants to contribute to a future without muscle diseases.
course_highlights: Supporting research into muscle diseases
Community-focused charity run
Organised by Sportcentrum Iedema
additional: The event supports the Prinses Beatrix Spierfonds and encourages participants to start individual fundraising campaigns, contribute as a team and raise money for research into muscle diseases. Participants are encouraged to fundraise and take part in an event that promotes exercise and community spirit.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 English miles (8 km), starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The run is known for its festive atmosphere, with great beats and light effects, making it a nonstop party for all participants. The event combines a sporting challenge with a lively atmosphere, ideal for runners looking for a special experience.
course_highlights: Evening run of 5 English miles (8 km)
Starts in Amsterdam, finishes in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a nonstop party with beats and light shows. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Extra products are also available to order, such as the official On Running shirt. The organizers focus on safety and preventing runners from overheating. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive finale. The 8 km race is known for its festive atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Werkhoven Loopt 2026
description: Werkhoven Loopt is a friendly and sporty running event in the Kromme Rijn region, held annually on the third Saturday of September. The 11th edition in 2026 offers running opportunities for all ages, with distances of 1 and 2 km for children and 5 and 10 km for adults. The event is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its welcoming, accessible atmosphere. Enthusiastic volunteers help make it an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Kromme Rijn region
Distances for children (1 and 2 km) and adults (5 and 10 km)
A friendly atmosphere with activities on the Brink
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 15:00 and 17:15. A warm-up is scheduled for 16:25. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities, with a festive atmosphere and various activities at the Brink hospitality square. Distances: 1 km (kids’ run), 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; advance registration is recommended; the event takes place at De Brink 5 in Werkhoven.

name: 4 Mijl van Assen

description: The 4 Mijl van Assen is an annual running event held in the Marsdijk district of Assen, starting and finishing at Anne Frank Plein. This ninth edition, on 19 September 2026, combines sport with a lively festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market. The run is suitable for all ages, with various categories including the main 4-mile distance, a College Run and a free Univé Kids Run for primary school pupils. The race also marks the start of Asser Sports Week and is an important event in the AssenRuns running circuit.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Anne Frank Plein in the Marsdijk district
Course through Assen’s northernmost district
Includes special events for frame runners (2 miles and 4 miles)
additional: The main 4-mile distance has a single start at 14:00, with the front starting pen reserved for the fastest runners. The Univé Kids Run starts at 11:55 with a group warm-up and is free, including a kids’ shirt and medal (while supplies last). Clinics are also offered for different groups to help them prepare for the 4 miles. On race day, a festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market takes place in Anne Frank Park. Registration is currently closed; the event includes running races, a festival, Kids Runs, a College Run, clinics and a sports market.

name: Nijmegen-Rotterdam
description: The Nijmegen-Rotterdam is the longest continuous walking event in the Netherlands, covering a distance of 160 km. The event starts on Saturday 19 September 2026 at 11.00 in Nijmegen and finishes on Sunday 20 September in Rotterdam. The route was renewed in 2022 and is improved every year, with six refreshments stops and various support stations along the way. The organisers provide a safe and well-supported walking experience, including first aid and foot care. Participants who complete the event successfully receive a certificate and a special keepsake.
course_highlights: 160 km continuous walking route from Nijmegen to Rotterdam
Six refreshments stops and several free support stations along the way
Route renewed in 2022 and improved every year
additional: The event starts in groups from Sporthal De Boog in Nijmegen. Registration is open from 9.30 to 10.30. Wearing a reflective vest is mandatory during the night; one can be rented or purchased at the start. An experienced first-aid and foot-care team will be on hand. A meal is served after approximately 60 km. If you withdraw, the entry fee is refunded minus a €5 administration fee. Discounts may be available for federation members and members of other associations. 160 km route, start in Nijmegen, finish in Rotterdam, including refreshments stops, support stations, a meal and first aid; reflective vests and flashlights are recommended.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
location: Museumpark VONK, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven takes place on Saturday, 19 September. Participants can choose between a 5 or 10 kilometre race, and there is also a 1-kilometre kids’ run for primary school children. The course is flat, fast and well paved, with the start and finish at Museumpark VONK in the renovated PreHistorische Dorp in Genneper Parken. After the run, participants can enjoy a delicious plant-based Beyond Meat burger, music and a convivial atmosphere with food trucks. There are great prizes for the fastest runners and special discounts for participants.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 or 10 kilometre course through Genneper Parken
Start and finish at Museumpark VONK, the renovated PreHistorische Dorp
Well-paved route with one or two laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 15:00 at Brasserie Vonk. Registration includes a plant-based Beyond Meat burger. Participants receive discount vouchers for All4running and Virtuoos nutritional supplements. Prize winners receive, among other things, Karhu running shoes, Shokz headphones and supplement packs. There will be music and a convivial atmosphere with food trucks after the finish. Flat course, start and finish at Museumpark VONK, including a burger, music, food trucks and a kids’ run.

description: The 11th edition of the Kwintelooyen Run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug nature area near Rhenen. This running event offers four distances: a 1 km kids’ run, and 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes that run entirely on natural terrain. The run supports charities that help children and young people with disabilities. Participants receive an exclusive Puma running shirt and a medal at the finish, making the event both sporty and festive.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely on natural terrain: forest paths, sandy paths, single trails and semi-paved paths
Beautiful climbs and panoramic views of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Quiet, traffic-free routes with no asphalt, cobblestones or traffic lights
additional: The kids’ run starts at 11:00, the 5 km at 12:00, the 10 km at 13:30 and the 15 km at 14:00. Participants in the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km receive an exclusive Puma running shirt when they collect their race number. Every runner receives a medal at the finish. Registration at the reduced rate is open through September 13; late registration is possible until September 18, while race bibs remain available. The event supports two charities: Stichting Netwerk voor Jou and Stichting De Wijde Mantel Q-Dreams. Register by September 13, 2026, for a discount; late registration is available. Participants receive medals and running shirts. The event takes place in Rhenen, in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug.

description: The Woellust Run is a friendly, accessible running event in Groningen, with distances for both children and adults. The 2.5-kilometre course winds through the neighbourhood with no fewer than 30 turns and plenty of enthusiastic supporters along the route. Children can take part in the 500- and 1,000-metre races, while adults can choose between 5 and 10 kilometres. There are great prizes to be won, including prize money for the top three in the 5- and 10-kilometre races and a special prize for setting a new course record.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km course with 30 turns
Run through the neighbourhood with plenty of supporters
Children’s races of 500 m and 1,000 m; adults’ races of 5 and 10 km
additional: Registration on the day of the run incurs a surcharge of € 2,50 per entry. The minimum age for the children’s 500 m race is 4–9 years, for the 1,000 m race 4–11 years, and for the 5 and 10 km races 10 years. The children’s race awards ceremony is at 14:30; the 5 and 10 km awards ceremony is at 16:00. Prize money is awarded to the top three in the 5 and 10 km races, and there is a special Primera course-record prize for new records in the 5 and 10 km races. The course starts at the intersection of Duintjerlaan and Sterrenboschlaan. Registration is open, with prizes for the top three and course records.

name: Mini Marathon Zeewolde

description: The Mini Marathon Zeewolde is an accessible running event held annually, with distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km for participants of different ages. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports the Conor Cares foundation, which works to fight childhood cancer. Start groups are divided by age, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in each category. Registration is free until 17 September; after that, the entry fee is 5.50 euros per participant.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km
Start groups divided by age
Friendly atmosphere with activities at Kerkplein
additional: The prize ceremonies are around 14:45 for the 1.1 km and 15:15 for the 2.1 km and 4.2 km. There is a relay category, with prizes for the fastest team across three age categories. After the finish, there is plenty to see and do at Kerkplein. Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km, including age-based start groups; a fundraiser for childhood cancer; registration is free until 17 September, then 5.50 euros.

Distances include the 1 km Kidsrun/FrameRunners, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. The routes head towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster. After the race, every participant receives a bag of products from FrieslandCampina, Dr. Oetker and Royal Koopmans. The Condensloop is excellent preparation for the Amsterdam or Eindhoven Marathon. Participation is at your own risk.
course_highlights: Start by the FrieslandCampina Condensfactory
Routes towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster
Distances from 1 km to the half marathon
additional: Race numbers have an integrated chip, so a separate chip is not needed. Race numbers can be collected at AV Lionitas on Thursday 17 September from 18:30 to 20:30. Registration is online only via iDEAL; there is no on-site registration. Aid stations are marked on the routes. GPX files for all distances are available to download and load onto a sports watch. Routes via afstandmeten.nl, chip timing, aid stations, changing facilities, no showers, prizes for records and categories, medals for the Kidsrun.

description: The Open Dutch National Stair Climbing Championship in Appelscha is an exciting stair-climbing race specially for young people aged 10 to 16. Participants race up the stairs of the Bosbergtoren as fast as possible, with speed and fitness at the heart of the event. The race takes place during the festive Bloeiweek and offers a unique chance to conquer the Bosberg and test your fitness. There is also a free fitness test in the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is free, but registration through Loopsportvereniging Invictus is required.
course_highlights: Climb the stairs of the Bosbergtoren
Start from the Boerestreek in the direction of the Bosbergtoren
Viewpoint at the top of the Bosberg
additional: Participants gather between 11:15 and 11:30 on the Boerestreek. A free fitness test is available in the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is at your own risk. Start time: 12:00. Registration is required for young participants. Event location: Bosbergtoren in Appelscha.

name: Run2day Bosloop Veenhuizen
description: The Run2day Bosloop in Veenhuizen is a friendly, small-scale running event held four times a year. The routes pass through the forests and heathland around Veenhuizen, with distances of 3, 5 and 10 kilometres, each on its own course. The start is at the sports hall on Kerklaan, which also has changing and shower facilities. The event is suitable for all ages and attracts an average of 40 to 100 participants per edition.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests and heathland around Veenhuizen
Distances of 3, 5 and 10 kilometres, each with its own route
Start and facilities at the sports hall on Kerklaan in Veenhuizen
additional: You can register on site from 9:00 to 10:15 or in advance using the registration form on the website, up to the Thursday before the event. Times are recorded, and results are available online within 2 days. A laptop displaying the recorded times is available in the sports hall canteen. The event takes place four times a year, with registration available in advance via the website or on site on the day. It is a small-scale event suitable for all ages.

name: Bolloop Lunetten
description: Bolloop Lunetten is a running event in the Lunetten neighbourhood of Utrecht, organised by Bewoners Overleg Lunetten together with Utrecht Atletiek. The event is part of Wijkdag and offers a 1 km Kids Run for children up to age 12, and 5 km and 10 km distances for older participants. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over, while anyone aged 4 and over can take part in the other distances. It is a classic road race with no frills, ideal for families, recreational runners and anyone who wants to run close to home. The event has been a fixture in the Lunetten calendar for several years and is celebrating an anniversary this year.
course_highlights: Road race in the Lunetten neighbourhood of Utrecht
Distances: 1 km Kids Run, 5 km and 10 km
Open to participants aged 4 and over (10 km from age 16)
additional: Registration is via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers a safe and organised environment for participants. Typical September weather is mild, with temperatures around 19°C and little rainfall. Road race, distances: 5 km, 10 km, Kids Run, registration via Inschrijven.nl

name: ‘kLEEF Run
description: The ‘kLEEF Run & Walk 2026 is a running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Veluwe in Apeldoorn. The event offers a sporty and convivial atmosphere for both runners and walkers. The start and finish are at Sportpark Orderbos, a well-known venue with good facilities. The event is suitable for different levels and ages, and participants can enjoy a scenic route in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos in Apeldoorn
Route through the natural surroundings of the Veluwe
Suitable for both runners and walkers
additional: The organizers provide changing rooms and shower facilities at CSV for AV Veluwe members on training and event days. The sports park is easily accessible by public transport and car. No specific information about start times, pricing or registration was found on the pages. Registration includes a race number, training courses and a reflective vest; location: Sportpark Orderbos, Apeldoorn

description: The Helderse Vallei Trailrun 2026 is an atmospheric trail run celebrating its sixth edition this year, in memory of Ineke Smit, one of the founders of this trail. The focus is on enjoying the natural surroundings and running on as many unpaved paths as possible, without timekeeping or performance pressure. The routes start at the open-air theatre at Helderse Vallei in Den Helder and offer various distances for adults and children. There are aid stations with water and fruit along the way, and the organisers are working with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland on a peace collection.
course_highlights: Trail run on as many unpaved paths as possible
Aid stations with water and fruit along the way
Start and finish at the open-air theatre at Helderse Vallei
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl or on race day at the Helderse Vallei visitor centre from 09:30. There is no timekeeping or registration during the run. The organisers are working with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland, and a collection box for donations to PAX will be available. Trail run on unpaved paths, beach and dunes; no timekeeping; routes start between 10:00 and 11:00, with aid stations offering water and fruit.

name: Run for Care
location: Krimpen aan de Lek, South Holland, Netherlands
description: On Saturday, September 19, 2026, the very first Run for Care will take place in the Krimpenerhout recreation area, near Krimpen aan de Lek. This is a 5- or 10-kilometer sponsored run for runners and walkers, where the goal is not the fastest time but the biggest heart. Participants can take part individually or as a team and raise sponsorship money to provide help and hope in Eastern Europe and Central Asia. Alongside the run, there will be a lively fair at the De Groene Weg charity shop, so family and friends can enjoy the day too.
course_highlights: A 5- or 10-kilometer sponsored run in the Krimpenerhout recreation area
Starts at 13:00; take part individually or as a team
A lively fair at the De Groene Weg charity shop on the same day
additional: Participants can register as individuals or as a team and create a personal fundraising page to raise sponsorship money. The event is being held to celebrate the 40th anniversary of OostEuropa Zending / Christian Care East West in Krimpen aan de Lek. Running and walking; participants aged 16 and over; registration open until September 16; includes a fair with activities for all ages.

name: NN Dam tot Damloop 2026

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the Netherlands’ biggest running festival, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10 English Miles route takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheering crowds in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, the event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive programme and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After the finish, you can enjoy the celebrations at the Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city centre and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam, with a street party on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration opens in stages: Le Champion members can register from 6 April through 17 April, after which general registration opens on 18 April. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular with companies, with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory race bib is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival at the Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from several distances, virtual options and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive, supportive atmosphere, with music and merchandise available.

name: StoneCityRun
description: The DYKA StoneCityRun is an atmospheric running event in Steenwijk, taking place on 20 September 2026. Participants run along the historic ramparts, through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk, with plenty of spectators and entertainment along the course. There are various distances for all ages and abilities, including special events such as the G-Run for people with disabilities and a walking tour. The event celebrates inclusivity and a friendly atmosphere, with the start at Theater de Meenthe and the finish at the Markt.
course_highlights: Run along Steenwijk’s historic ramparts
Through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk
Finish at the atmospheric Markt in Steenwijk
additional: After registration closes, it is possible to collect a blank bib at the start location, De Meenthe, from 13:00 on 20 September, without timekeeping. Children under 6 must be accompanied, and those accompanying children or people with disabilities may participate for free. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start location, and parking is available. The rollator run is specifically for older people, and the G-Run is inclusive, with support and assistive aids permitted. Participants can choose from various distances, including 0.6 km, 1.5 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event also offers walks and special runs for people with disabilities, as well as parking, changing rooms and showers. Registration closes on 1 September 2026.

name: LOS Dokkum
distance_verbose: 50 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 13.4 km, 6.7 km
organizer: Stichting Promotie Dokkum en stichting Ik ben Wil
description: LOS Dokkum is a unique 12-hour running and walking event in Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Every hour, the starting signal sounds for a 6.7-kilometre running lap or a 3.9-kilometre walking lap. The challenge is to decide how long you can keep going and answer the question again each time: shall I do one more lap? The event combines sporting spirit with a convivial atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A 6.7-kilometre running lap each hour
A 3.9-kilometre walking route through Tolhuispark
Starting signal every hour for 12 hours
additional: The event takes place in Tolhuispark. Participants can choose between running and walking. The starting signal sounds again every hour, giving the event a unique dynamic. The event supports charitable causes and is backed by volunteers and local businesses. It is open to teams and children, and is part of an annual initiative.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: The Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is an atmospheric running event in the green surroundings of Gravenallee in Almelo. The event offers distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including a new 2-kilometre youth and beginners’ run. The start and finish are at the ice rink opposite the sports park, with a course along wide avenues in a much-loved, atmospheric setting. It promises to be a sporty and enjoyable day for athletes, supporters and visitors of all ages.
course_highlights: Course along wide avenues in the green Gravenallee
Start and finish at the ice rink opposite the sports park
Atmospheric setting, with support from Huize Almelo
additional: Distances for all ages and levels, including a new 2-kilometre youth and beginners’ run. Start and finish at IJsbaan Almelo, Sluiskade Zuidzijde 195, 7607XT Almelo. The event runs from 10:30 to 13:00. Routes through rural areas, the option to train with athletics club SISU, participation for all ages, and a focus on health and community.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.09 km, 8 km, 3000 meter, 1.6 km
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is a recreational running event held in Geldrop to celebrate 80 years of liberation. The race offers four running distances, named after well-known veterans, and a half marathon. There is also a free Kidsrun for primary school children, as well as several walking routes past war memorials and streets named after resistance fighters. The event emphasizes celebrating freedom together and offers a unique combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: Four running distances named after veterans: 4, 8 and 10 miles, and a half marathon
Walking routes past war memorials and streets named after resistance fighters in Geldrop
Free Kidsrun for primary school children, with 1/2-mile and 1-mile distances
additional: Start times vary by distance: walking starts between 9:00 and 10:00, the Kidsrun at 10:15, and running between 10:45 and 11:15. Walking and running routes are available as GPX files. Participation is at your own risk, and walking is free for children up to and including age 15. Registration opens on 5 May via the website. Participants can choose from several distances, including 3 km, 1.6 km, 8 km, 10 miles and a half marathon. The event takes place at the Weeffabriek in Geldrop and starts on 20 September 2026. Registration opens on 5 May 2026.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Rondjes van Pijn is an endurance run organized by IJsvereniging Pijnacker, held on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeated 4.2-kilometer laps starting every half hour, with a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace: completing a lap faster means more rest before the next start. The event is aimed at both young people and adults and emphasizes endurance over speed.
course_highlights: Repeated 4.2 km laps starting every half hour
Up to ten laps possible
Course in and around the Tinteltent, Pijnacker
additional: Participation is at your own risk; participants are responsible for their own training and insurance. The course is shared with recreational users, and traffic marshals are present at some challenging spots. Dogs are welcome on parts of the course. Repeated 4.2 km laps, maximum distance of approximately 42 km, registration via the website, dogs welcome on parts of the course, and safety and personal responsibility are emphasized.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: The Maasheggenloop, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, takes place on September 20, 2026, in the beautiful Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands. The event offers a suitable distance for every age and ability, from the Bambinoloop for the youngest children to the Half Marathon for experienced runners. The routes pass through a unique, nature-rich setting, with a cash prize for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10 km. The atmosphere is sporty and welcoming, with fun keepsakes for all youth participants and trophies for the podium finishers.
course_highlights: Run through the Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands
Distances range from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon
Cash prizes for breaking the course record in the 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 09:45 for the Bambinoloop to 11:00 for the 5 km. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance. All youth participants receive a fun keepsake, and podium finishers receive trophies. There is a cash prize of 100 Euro for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10 km. Distances for all ages, course records, registration via website, refreshments and first aid available

name: Molenbroekloop
price_range: gratis voor GAC-leden, anders niet vermeld
